plugins.description:
@imqueue is an open-source TypeScript framework for building microservices that
talk over a message queue instead of HTTP — you write a class, decorate the
methods you want to publish, and callers get a fully-typed client generated from
the running service.

This server gives your assistant first-hand knowledge of it, so it writes real
@imqueue code instead of plausible-looking code.

search_docs covers the guides, the tutorial, the CLI manual, the articles, and
every exported symbol of every @imqueue package that publishes an API reference —
so you can ask a question in plain words ("how do I expose a service method?") or
look up an exact signature ("RedisQueue.send", "IMQOptions.safeDelivery"). It
ranks with the same engine imqueue.org's own search uses, so the site and this
server agree about which page answers a question, and licensing and pricing
questions answer from imqueue.com rather than the framework docs. A result can
point at a section rather than a whole page, and get_doc follows that anchor:
give it a URL with a #fragment and it returns just that section, with the heading
path above it and its position on the page, so you can see what was left out and
ask for the rest. Without a fragment it returns the whole page as plain markdown
for reading and quoting. list_packages returns the current package catalogue with
install commands, which is how an assistant picks the right one rather than
guessing at a name. Where two packages cover the same ground — tracing, or the
database layer — the results carry the rule for choosing exactly one, because
installing both breaks quietly rather than loudly.

package_status answers the version question outright: the current version,
licence, minimum Node version and release date of one @imqueue package or of all
of them, read from imqueue.org at the moment you ask rather than recalled. It
also answers for the framework as a whole — the Node and Redis floors, and a
licence note that states the licence terms in a sentence.
plugins.author: MYKHAILO STADNYK

plugins.name: 1f916
plugins.description:
1F916 keeps a tamper-evident record of what an AI agent was told and what it did. Before acting, the assistant records the instruction and the action it is about to take. Afterwards it adds the result to the same record. It can also seal a memory, so a later session can check whether it changed.

Each record is chained into a public log. Every few minutes the registry signs a stamp over the whole log, independent witnesses countersign the stamps, and copies are sent to Bitcoin (OpenTimestamps) and Base. A record altered afterwards would no longer match the published stamps, and anyone can check that with the inclusion and consistency proofs this app returns.

By default only fingerprints (SHA-256) are public. The text stays with you, or is stored encrypted to your key.

This app moves no money and calls nothing outside the 1F916 registry. Reading needs no sign-in. Writing asks you to sign in once: register the assistant as an agent with its own 1F916 handle, or connect one that already exists.

1to1 Mate is a relationship management app built around 1:1 meetings.

It is an "external memory" tool for people whose work depends on stacking one-on-one conversations — sales professionals,
community builders, managers, founders, advisors, and anyone who runs recurring 1:1s.

CORE FEATURES

・Member management: Structured storage of each person's goals, values, skills, referral needs, background, and tags
・AI meeting notes: Automatic transcription of meeting audio with AI-generated summaries and action items
・Dashboard: Chronological view of who you met, when, and what you discussed
・Profile import: Extract member information from business cards or web pages
・Referral matching: AI suggests who to introduce to whom based on past conversations

Note: the above are features of the 1to1 Mate app itself. Audio transcription, new meeting note creation, and member
registration all happen inside the 1to1 Mate app. The MCP / ChatGPT integration only provides read-only access to data already
 recorded through those features.

WHAT YOU CAN DO WITH CHATGPT

Once you connect 1to1 Mate to ChatGPT, you can ask things like:

・"Draft the next agenda for my 1:1 with Tanaka based on what we discussed last time."
・"Find members who are struggling with marketing."
・"Who on my member list would be a good introduction for Yamada, given her goals?"
・"Summarize the action items I committed to across last month's 1:1s."

The AI reads your data on a strictly read-only basis. Nothing is modified or deleted through this connection.

PERMISSIONS & DATA HANDLING

・Available on all plans, including the free plan
・Authentication via OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; sign in with your Google account
・Raw contact details (phone numbers, email addresses, messaging IDs) are never exposed to the AI. Not even the channel type label is returned — the MCP layer simply omits all contact-related fields
・You can disconnect the integration at any time from your account settings

See https://1to1mate.com/guide/mcp for the

plugins.description:
Adplane connects your Google Ads and Meta Ads accounts to ChatGPT so you can analyze performance and make changes in the same conversation.

Ask questions in plain language and get answers from your live account data, on either platform or both at once. Compare campaigns across any date range, find where spend is going, pull search terms, put Google and Meta results side by side, or write raw GAQL when you need something the report builder does not cover. Money is returned in your account currency, already converted, so numbers can be read as-is.

Adplane also builds and changes campaigns. On Google it can create Search campaigns, ad groups, keywords, and responsive search ads, and add negative keywords. On Meta it can create campaigns, ad sets, ads, and creatives built from images and video you provide, with live previews. On both platforms it can update names, budgets, bids, and status on things that already exist.

Everything Adplane creates starts paused. A new campaign cannot serve or spend until you explicitly ask to turn it on, and turning something on is a separate, deliberate step through a single tool per platform. Negative keywords only restrict where ads show and can never spend. Deleting is limited to removing a campaign that has never spent, for cleaning up a draft you abandoned; there is no bulk delete. Every change is read back from the platform after it is applied, so what you see reported is what the platform actually stored.

Connecting takes one click. Sign in with the Google account you already use for Google Ads and every account you have access to is connected at once. Meta ad accounts connect from your accounts page with a Facebook sign-in.

Requires a Google Ads or Meta ad account and an Adplane account at adplane.ai.

plugins.description:
AImport.AR connects ChatGPT to Argentine import data from official public sources (ARCA customs records, INDEC and the BCRA), normalized and updated as each month is published.

What you can ask:
- Search and summaries: a free-text search that returns the identifier for each follow-up tool, one month of imports at a glance, what is new since the last query, two to four products or origin countries side by side, the seasonality of a product, and the official source and file behind every figure.
- Markets by product: imports of any NCM tariff line or chapter, month by month, with the main buyers, origin countries and China's share.
- Importers: who imports each product, company profiles, rankings for a chosen window (last closed month, 3, 6 or 12 months, or between two months, optionally from one origin), who is rising, and side-by-side comparisons.
- Product radars: Chinese cars (by powertrain, with brands attributed per importer), mobile phones, agricultural machinery and solar panels.
- Countries of origin, customs offices, ports and cargo ships in Argentine waters, and how much Argentina depends on China and at what price.
- Prices and costs: unit prices paid by importers, the duties and taxes actually paid per tariff line, a landed-cost breakdown, and the courier small-shipment regime with each rule cited.
- Opportunities: emerging products and markets with room for new suppliers.

Le savant travaille dans le parcours exact de l'élève — sa classe, sa voie, ses spécialités et ses options. Il ouvre le cours d'une notion avec ses figures, ses prérequis et ses compétences, cherche dans le programme de l'année, propose les exercices un par un, du plus accessible au plus exigeant, et s'appuie sur des corrigés détaillés pour guider pas à pas plutôt que donner la réponse d'emblée. plugins.description:
Algorithmic Ink turns your photos into geometric artwork directly inside ChatGPT. Transform a portrait, pet photo, object or landscape into spiral FM line art, scribble drawings, circle stippling or triangle art, then preview and refine the result in an interactive studio.
Start by attaching a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo to your conversation, or choose a photo through the studio’s file picker. Describe the style you want, select ink and background colors, and adjust the drawing controls to change detail, contrast, line weight and other style-specific settings. Optional background removal isolates the subject; turn it off to preserve the complete scene.
Continue refining your artwork through conversation or the studio’s controls. For example, ask to switch from spiral lines to scribble art, make the lines thinner, or change the colors while keeping the same photo. When the artwork is ready, download an SVG for further editing in compatible design software or a PNG for convenient viewing and sharing.
Image processing and artwork generation run locally in your browser while the studio is open. Algorithmic Ink does not maintain a server-side library of your photos or finished artwork. The ChatGPT integration processes photo references and drawing settings, and shares rendering status, settings and a small artwork preview with ChatGPT to support follow-up requests. Photos selected in the studio are uploaded to ChatGPT when its upload feature is available, and exports may pass through ChatGPT’s download feature. The privacy policy explains these data flows, recipients, retention and user controls.
No separate Algorithmic Ink account is required, and Algorithmic Ink currently charges no usage fee. The app creates artwork from existing photos; it does not generate images from text alone, produce videos, or provide printing and shipping services. Processing speed and download availability depend on your device, browser and ChatGPT’s supported features.
plugins.author: MAHFOUZ ALCHEIKH

Isometric is an agentic certification platform for the industrial economy, and the world's leading carbon removal registry. This app connects ChatGPT to the Isometric MCP server at https://api.isometric.com/mcp so suppliers, verifiers and partners can bring authoritative Isometric context into their conversations.

What you can do:
- Read the Isometric Standard and every certified protocol (e.g. Direct Air Capture, Biochar, Enhanced Weathering) at any version, and ask precise questions about their requirements, citing the protocol text.
- Read all the information you have access to in Certify and Registry: your projects, issues, credits, documents and everything else the platform shows you.
- Browse Isometric's product documentation: the Certify and Registry user guides.
- Browse Isometric's API documentation, including the full OpenAPI descriptions of the Certify and Registry REST APIs.
- Follow Isometric's skills: step-by-step guides for common workflows using this plugin.
- Act on your own work where the platform allows it, such as commenting on an issue or updating a project you manage.

plugins.description:
AudiencePlayer is a white-label video platform that media companies, broadcasters and content creators use to publish and manage video, audio and articles. This connector lets the technical administrators and content managers of an AudiencePlayer platform operate it from ChatGPT, with the same access they have in the AudiencePlayer CMS.

What you can do
- Content: create, update, clone, sort and delete Articles, Categories, Pages and Menus, and attach images and other files.
- Media: manage video, audio and live Assets, follow upload and encoding status, and run live streams and recordings.
- Platform set-up: configure the Products, Subscriptions and vouchers of your own platform. This is configuration only: no purchases or payments are made through the connector.
- Users and messaging: look up and manage Users, notifications and mail templates.
- Insight: ask for viewing, streaming, storage and subscription statistics.
- Configuration: read and update project settings.

How it works
You sign in with your own AudiencePlayer administrator account. ChatGPT then acts within that account's permissions, on the project you signed in to. Tools that change or delete data are labelled, so ChatGPT asks before it makes changes.

Requirements
This connector is for AudiencePlayer customers who have API integration included in their contract. You need an AudiencePlayer platform with API integration and an administrator account on it.

What it does not do
Payments, refunds, password resets, logging in as another user and deleting users are not available through the connector.

Please note
The connector gives ChatGPT administrator-level access to your platform, including the personal data of your users. Only connect it if you trust that access, and review what ChatGPT proposes before you approve changes, especially deletions and starting live streams.

plugins.description:
Autosheet lets ChatGPT run a specialized spreadsheet agent directly in Google Sheets. Describe what you need in plain language — the agent inspects the spreadsheet, plans the steps, performs work, and reports back.

Delegate most tasks involving a Google Sheet including simply reading data or inspecting structure — it's reliable, fast, token-efficient, and helps keep context clean.

Everyday tasks:
- Create, fix, and explain formulas
- Build charts, pivot tables, and dashboards
- Format and style cells, ranges, and entire sheets
- Restructure data into clean, organized rows, columns, and sheets
- Web research

Row-by-row bulk processing with AI at up to 1,000 rows per minute:
- Enrich and categorize product catalogs for e-commerce and merchandising
- Generate, rewrite, and translate content at scale for SEO and localization
- Enrich and score leads for sales outbound through bulk web search
- Clean, standardize, and deduplicate messy data across any dataset

Beyond these, teams use Autosheet wherever work lives in a spreadsheet: accounting, finance, HR, inventory, education, and more.

How it works:

Give ChatGPT a prompt and a Google Sheets URL or ID. Autosheet launches an agent on that spreadsheet and returns the result. Long jobs keep running server-side — check status or stop an agent at any time. Follow-up requests continue on the same spreadsheet with full context. The agent works directly in the spreadsheet and can add, change, or remove content.

Authentication through OAuth: you grant access to your own Google Sheets. Works with any spreadsheet you can edit.

Built by Talarian, the team behind the GPT for Sheets and Docs add-on (7M+ installs on the Google Workspace Marketplace). New accounts start with free trial credits.

plugins.description:
A scaffold design sits finished in Avontus Viewer, and you need an answer before the crew starts loading. How much does the job weigh? What goes on the third lift? Will the whole bill of materials fit on one truck? Finding out usually means opening the design, working down the parts list, and doing the arithmetic yourself.

Avontus Viewer puts those questions to ChatGPT instead.

Connect your Avontus Viewer account and ChatGPT can read the scaffold designs you own, along with the ones your colleagues have shared with you. Ask for a bill of materials and you get every part, its quantity, and what a single piece weighs, with a total in pounds or kilograms, whichever you work in. Request the parts by elevation and the placed scaffolding comes back grouped by level, so you can stage a delivery or plan a lift. Where a design carries Scaffold Units, the surface area, volume, leg length and other quantities Avontus Designer calculates for estimating, they are there too, in US or metric measure and never a mix of both. You can also pull up the rendered preview image.

If you estimate labor, there is more here. Tell the connector your own labor unit, say 6 min per piece, and it applies that to the real quantity from your design and shows the arithmetic. Add productivity factors for congestion or elevation and it is built to ask how your procedure combines them rather than assuming. What it does not supply is the labor unit itself. Those belong to your Schedule of Norms or your own recorded actuals, because nobody else's productivity figures describe your crews. Piece counts and weights come from every design, so the calculation holds even on exports too old to carry Scaffold Units.

Some questions need Avontus know-how rather than a design. Ask how to handle scaffold inventory, equipment on rent or invoicing, or ask for a stair tower to be designed, and the connector looks it up in the Avontus product documentation at docs.avontus.com, then answers from Avontus Quantify or A

What you can do with it
#1 Spot the pattern behind your visibility
- "Why don't AI assistants recommend my business?" 
Reads across every prompt you're missing from and names what they have in common.

#2 Find your competitor's edge
- "Why did my competitor jump ahead this month?"
Pulls the competitor leaderboard, then narrows it to what they did or what changed to cause it.

#3 Prioritize your next content fix
- "I can fix only one thing this month, what should I do?”
Ranks your content improvements by impact rather than listing every gap flat, so you know exactly where to start and what to do.

#4 Understand what moved your score
- "What changed in my AI visibility this month?" 
Checks the score trend against the topic and prompt movement to tell you whether it's a real shift.

#5 Build a client-ready report
- "Build this month's AI visibility summary for my client" 
Draws the score, competitor standing, and top fixes, and writes it up as a report that you can paste anywhere.

#6 Know what a metric actually means
- "What does [metric] mean for my visibility, and should I care about it?"
Explains what a metric measures or gives a read on your visibility state in simple words.

How to get started
- Sign in with a Beamtrace account.
- The app reads live data from your connected website.
- No setup beyond that; start the conversation.

Ask a question in plain language and get an analysis scoped to your business.

Requirements
Your business needs an active subscription or trial. A website must be connected to the service. If it isn't, ChatGPT points you

Biohacking Kompakt ist eine deutschsprachige Faktencheck-Datenbank zu Supplements, Peptiden, Therapien und Longevity-Themen. Zu jedem Thema gibt es den BK-Score: fünf Achsen, die den Wissensstand beschreiben – wie gut am Menschen untersucht, wie gut die Sicherheitslage untersucht ist, wie lange und breit angewendet, wie plausibel der Mechanismus und wie weit die Werbung der Datenlage voraus ist (Hype-Abstand: 10 heißt, die Werbung deckt sich mit den Daten). Dazu die Richtung, in die die vorhandene Evidenz zeigt, und die passende Folge des Podcasts „Biohacking Kompakt“. Außerdem kann sie alle Artikel, Tipps, Vergleiche und Folgenseiten von biohackingkompakt.de im Volltext durchsuchen und beantwortet so auch konkrete Fragen wie „Wann nehme ich NMN am besten?“ mit dem Wortlaut der Seite. Dazu kommen der Signalwege-Atlas (mTOR, AMPK, Sirtuine …), der direkte Score-Vergleich mehrerer Themen, die Kennzahlen des Biohacking-Reports und das Änderungsprotokoll.

Der Score bewertet den Wissensstand, nicht die Substanz. Die App liest live von biohackingkompakt.de, verkauft nichts und gibt keine medizinische Beratung. Zu verschreibungspflichtigen und nicht zugelassenen Substanzen liefert sie ausschließlich die Einordnung der Studienlage – ohne Dosierung, ohne Anwendung, ohne Bezugsquelle.

State and international authority is included where the question calls for it.

- Researching a client position before you commit to it on a return
- Checking whether recent legislation or guidance changes an answer you already relied on
- Working through cross-border and multistate questions where the authority is scattered
- Building the technical support behind a memo, a client email, or a workpaper
- Getting oriented on an issue outside your usual specialty

Because the connector runs inside ChatGPT, the research sits alongside the rest of your work. You can pull up a client email, research the question it raises, and draft the reply in one thread.

Every tool in this connector is read only. Bizora retrieves and analyzes tax authority without creating, modifying, or deleting your client records or research source material. Research usage is metered against your Bizora account credit balance.

Bizora is a research tool, not a substitute for professional judgment. Review the cited authority before relying on any answer in client work.

Bond Memory lets ChatGPT make choices grounded in your real preferences, past experiences, and the facts you have shared with Bond.

- Pick for you: give ChatGPT a few options (restaurants, products, movies, gifts, plans) and it picks the one you are most likely to prefer, and explains why.
- Worth telling you: before ChatGPT surfaces a deal, event, or find you did not ask about, it can check whether it clears your personal bar.

Access is read-only. Nothing ChatGPT does through Bond Memory can change or delete anything in Bond.

Give it an asset, an amount and a schedule — daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly — and a start date, and it returns what you put in, what it would be worth at the last close, the profit, the simple and money-weighted returns, the units held, and end-of-year checkpoints along the way. It can compare plans side by side and rank them, and it can return the individual purchases behind any figure.

Every answer carries a link that reopens the same run in the web app, pinned to the exact data it was computed from, so a number in a conversation can be checked rather than taken on faith. Prices come from published daily closes; inflation and rate series come from the St. Louis Fed. There is no forecasting, no advice, and no trading — it reads history and does the sums.

Free with no account: seven assets including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Solana, XRP, the S&P 500, the Nasdaq 100 and gold, and two plans per comparison. A BTC DCA Engine account covers the rest of the catalogue, larger comparisons, and the risk, inflation, lump-sum and rules-based overlays.

plugins.description:
CalorieGoals is a calorie and nutrient food log.

Once connected, you can log what you eat by describing it. Say "I had a bowl of oatmeal with blueberries" and it finds each food, chooses a portion for it, and records it against your day. Ask "how many calories do I have left today?" and it answers from the goal you set. Water and exercise are logged the same way.

Recipes and food groups can be built by describing them, and are saved to your library to reuse later. Nutrition figures come from the USDA FoodData Central database and from the foods you have saved yourself, not from the assistant.

Plan a day ahead and eat from it. A meal plan is a day of food decided in advance; put it on a date or on the weekdays it repeats on, then ask "what am I eating today?" and log it without searching for any of it again, because the plan already names the food, the portion and the amount. Ask what you need to buy for the week and it adds the planned days up into a shopping list, breaking recipes down into their ingredients.

What it can and cannot reach. Logging can be dated, so "I had this yesterday" works. Removing takes one entry at a time, from today or a day still to come — including entries you added in the app yourself — so anything it can put on a future day it can take off again. Deleting from a day already past is done in the app, by you.

The connection is read and write over your food, exercise and water log, your saved recipes, food groups and meal plans, and the calorie goals you set. It cannot see your name, email address or billing details.

plugins.description:
Worldbuilding and tabletop RPGs
Build the world your players come back to each week. Create a city, the factions fighting over it and the NPC who secretly works for both sides. Save them in your campaign, build an encounter around their next move, and use your session notes to remember which side the party promised to help.

Image, video and audio generation
Make a character portrait, illustrate a location or edit an image from your gallery. Turn a harbour painting into a video with a flickering lighthouse, compose music for the docks, or give the ferryman a voice. You can also add sound effects to a clip you already have.

Game assets and animation
Turn a character from your gallery into a pixel art sprite sheet for your RPG. Choose four or eight directions and poses for walking, fighting or casting spells. For environment art, turn a location sketch into a 3D-style diorama illustration.

Getting started
Connect your CharGen account. For image-based workflows, select an image from your gallery. Available tools depend on your account. Generated library entries are public by default; you can change their visibility in CharGen.

Try these prompts

• @CharGen, Create a town built around a sleeping giant. Give me two rival factions and the NPC who keeps their truce.

• @CharGen, Build a flooded crypt encounter for four level-three adventurers. Give them a way past the guardian without fighting.

• @CharGen, Paint the crypt guardian in tarnished armour, with reeds growing through its visor.

• @CharGen, Turn my crypt illustration into a short video. Keep the camera still as water seeps under the door.

• @CharGen, Make a sound cue for the stone door opening. Start with a scrape and end with a heavy thud.

• @CharGen, Turn my guardian portrait into a four-direction pixel sprite sheet with idle and walk poses.

plugins.description:
Schedule LinkedIn posts and publish to LinkedIn from ChatGPT. Chime is a LinkedIn post scheduler and social media scheduler that works right in the chat, for creators, founders, personal branding coaches and social media agencies. Write a LinkedIn post with ChatGPT, say when it should go out in your own words ("Tuesday at 9am", "tomorrow morning"), and it is published on your LinkedIn profile at that time. Chime Scheduler turns your words into an exact time in your time zone and echoes it back, so you can catch a wrong time before anything goes live.

Use it as your LinkedIn content calendar and post scheduler: plan a week of LinkedIn content in one chat, schedule the posts in a batch, and keep a steady posting rhythm for your personal brand. Without leaving the chat you can:
- Schedule LinkedIn posts for later, or save them as drafts.
- Publish to LinkedIn right now and get the live post link back.
- Add a first comment, such as a link, a few seconds after the post goes live.
- Post images (up to 9) or one MP4 video. In ChatGPT you can also attach images or a video in the chat. Or ask for a private, single-use upload link, and confirm the files in the chat before they are attached.
- See your scheduled, draft and published LinkedIn posts, reschedule or edit any post that has not gone out yet, and cancel posts.
- Delete a post that is already live on LinkedIn. ChatGPT asks you first, because it can't be undone.
- Check that your LinkedIn account is connected and when the login expires.

How it works: you connect with Sign In with LinkedIn. Posts are published through LinkedIn's official API, only when you ask, and only on your own personal profile. Chime Scheduler never reads your LinkedIn feed, messages or connections. If a post can't go out (for example an expired LinkedIn login), it is held, never posted late without you choosing to, and ChatGPT tells you what to do next.

Limitations: personal LinkedIn profiles only (company pages are not supported), posts up to

plugins.description:
청연(청소연구소)의 청소·생활 서비스 정보를 안내합니다. (주)청연이 직접 운영하며, 공식 홈페이지의 서비스 정보와 가격을 그대로 전달합니다.

[할 수 있는 일]
• 서비스 둘러보기 — 가사 청소, 원룸·화장실·냉장실 청소, 에어컨·세탁기 청소, 이사입주 청소, 사무실 청소, 옷장 정리, 집수리, 청연케어(어르신 돌봄), 청연 한상(반찬 배송)을 한눈에 보여줍니다.
• 서비스 내용 확인 — 서비스 하나가 어떤 작업을 포함하는지, 추가 요금이 붙는 항목은 무엇인지 알려줍니다.
• 서비스 지역 확인 — "성남시 분당구에서 가사청소 되나요?"처럼 지역을 말하면 이용 가능 여부를 알려줍니다.
• 가격 확인 — 평수별 최소 인원, 예상 소요 시간, 예상 비용을 표로 보여줍니다.
• 고객센터 안내 — 예약 변경·취소, 환불, 매니저 관련 요청, 파손, 결제 문제의 접수 경로와 연락처, 운영시간을 안내합니다.

[이런 분께 맞습니다]
집·사무실 청소를 알아보는 중이거나, 특정 서비스의 범위와 비용을 미리 확인하고 싶은 분. 이미 이용 중이라면 문의 경로를 빠르게 찾을 수 있습니다.

[할 수 없는 일]
• 예약을 만들거나 변경·취소하지 않습니다. 예약은 청연 앱에서 진행하며, 여기서는 안내만 합니다.
• 고객님의 예약 내역, 쿠폰, 포인트를 조회하지 않습니다.
• 결제나 환불을 처리하지 않습니다.

[데이터 취급]
로그인이 필요 없으며 개인정보를 수집하거나 저장하지 않습니다. 서비스 범위와 가격은 공식 홈페이지에서 읽어오므로 금액을 임의로 추정하지 않고, 안내하는 링크는 모두 청연 공식 도메인입니다.

plugins.description:
Clairwave gives ChatGPT grounded ocean-acoustics answers instead of estimates from memory. Ask about any point in the world ocean and the plugin runs propagation physics on Clairwave's platform: parabolic-equation transmission loss along a bearing, sonar-equation detection ranges, and full 3D Bellhop transmission-loss volumes, driven by Clairwave-served bathymetry, seasonal sound-speed profiles and seabed acoustic parameters.

It also covers ships: search live AIS positions by name or MMSI, list vessels near a point, estimate a vessel's radiated-noise source level from its class, speed and dimensions, fetch a photo, open an MMSI-keyed 3D hull model from the open shipshape fleet, and compute the power-summed noise level at a fixed site such as a fish farm or hydrophone.

Every location accepts a place name ("outside Halifax", "Strait of Hormuz") as well as coordinates. Every simulation result carries a replication bundle (sound-speed profile, bottom parameters, bathymetry transect, grid) and a run id whose files are downloadable, plus a link that opens the run visualized in the Clairwave web platform with no sign-in.

Typical uses: sonar and hydrophone planning, marine-mammal noise exposure screening, aquaculture noise monitoring, teaching ocean acoustics, checking a ship's audibility at a receiver, and exploring how season and seabed change propagation. No account is required. Compute calls share a platform-wide budget of about 20 per minute. Results are climatology-based and are not a substitute for in-situ measurements.

Connect AI is a sales workspace for export teams that keeps overseas buyer contacts, sales projects, buyer interest signals, and recommended follow-ups in one place. Connecting this connector lets you look up and organize that data in your own account, and write email drafts, during a conversation.

Every change takes two steps. A preview tool first shows what will change, and the matching apply tool saves it only after you confirm. It never sends mail: it only creates and edits drafts, and you send them yourself in Connect AI.

Contacts are handled as opaque references; email addresses, phone numbers, postal addresses, mailbox content, and payment information are never returned. Email draft subjects and bodies are returned only by the draft lookup tool. Strings returned by the tools are marked as untrusted quoted data and are not interpreted as instructions. The connection goes through OAuth 2.0 and applies only to the single organization you explicitly select.

33 tools are provided.
- 13 lookup tools: search contacts and get a contact overview, list projects and get project metrics, list interest signals, list recommended follow-up actions, list change targets (contacts, projects, signals, actions), list and get email drafts, and get operation status.
- 10 preview tools, each with a matching apply tool: add or edit a contact; create, update, complete or reopen a project; link or unlink a project's contacts and set the deal stage; mark an interest signal viewed or snooze it; acknowledge or snooze a recommended action; edit a draft; generate a draft for a contact; generate a draft for a project; regenerate a draft; translate a draft.

- Variante A: ein Link zu unserem Anfrageformular, in dem alle Angaben bereits ausgefüllt sind. Sie ergänzen Ihre Kontaktdaten und senden selbst ab.

Die Containerdienste melden sich mit ihren Angeboten direkt bei Ihnen.

Unterstützte Abfallarten: Bauschutt, Baumischabfall, Sperrmüll, Erdaushub, Grünschnitt, Holz, Metall, Papier/Pappe, Dachpappe, Gips, Asbest und Sonstiges. Der Dienst ist auf Deutschland beschränkt. Keine Anmeldung erforderlich.

Contexter is memory that stays the same in every AI you use. What you save in ChatGPT is there when you open Claude or write to the Telegram bot, and what arrives in Telegram is there for ChatGPT. No copying, no explaining the project again in a new chat.

How it works
- Save a result of your work (a plan, a list, a summary, a decision) into a context: a folder for one project or idea.
- Add notes, photos and files from Telegram: send them to the bot, or let it collect a group chat you have joined.
- Ask about a context in any assistant and continue where you stopped yesterday, even if that was a different AI.
- Share a context with a person: they read it in their own AI, and both of you add to it.

What ChatGPT can do with Contexter connected
- list your contexts and show what each one holds;
- read a context's records and answer from them;
- save a result into a context, or update a saved list instead of making a second copy;
- tell you who will see a record before it lands in a shared context;
- send a result into a Telegram group chat you take part in, or post an invitation link so the people there can join a shared context, both only when you ask for it.

What Contexter never does
Nothing is saved silently: every write happens on your explicit request. Deletions are reversible for 7 days. Shared contexts always show their audience. Nothing is collected from your conversation beyond what you ask to save.

plugins.description:
Converly is the easiest way to send conversions to Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Google Analytics 4, and more when someone submits a form, schedules an appointment or starts a chat on your site.

This plugin makes it super easy to set up. You simply say things like 'Send conversions to ChatGPT Ads when someone submits the contact form on my website' and the plugin will set up a conversion flow, give you a snippet of code to add to your site, and test that it's all set up and working.

It can detect conversions in 100+ tools, including Gravity Forms, WPForms, Contact Form 7, Typeform, Jotform, Webflow Forms, Wix Forms, Squarespace Forms, Calendly, Acuity Scheduling, Cal.com & more.

It can send conversions to 20+ destinations, including Google Analytics, Google Ads, Meta Ads, ChatGPT Ads, Microsoft Ads, LinkedIn Ads, TikTok Ads, Reddit Ads and more.

Converly supports conditional logic so you can decide exactly when a conversion fires, such as when someone submits your Quote Request form but not your Contact Support form.

Instead of relying on the visitor's browser to send conversions, Converly sends conversions directly to the ad platforms' servers, where ad blockers and privacy restrictions in iOS and Safari can't get in the way.

It also captures the lead's name, email, phone, click IDs, IP address, device, etc and sends it with the conversion. This gives ad platforms the data they need to match the conversion back to a real person and the original ad they clicked. Ultimately, this means you get more accurate conversion data, and your ad platform can understand what a good lead looks like for your business so it can go find more of them.

Converly gives you a full debug log that shows exactly what was captured, what was sent where, and whether it arrived successfully. You can even query it through the plugin by saying something like 'Is my conversion tracking working properly' and it will query the log and respond.

Lleva el diario de campo de cada parcela, planifica visitas y tareas, y resuelve la parte técnica y normativa de la explotación: tratamientos fitosanitarios, fertilización y riego, planes de abonado, eco-regímenes, almacén y documentación.

El asistente lee y escribe en el cuaderno del usuario, y recomienda productos fitosanitarios autorizados buscando en el registro oficial del Ministerio de Agricultura (MAPA) y leyendo la ficha oficial del producto como fuente de verdad. Keep your project context available across conversations.

Cube Memory connects ChatGPT to the memories, documents, notes, and source code in your authorized project. Find earlier decisions, open the exact passage or code symbol a search returns, and pick up long tasks where you left off.

Use it to:
- Recall project decisions and saved context.
- Search documents and open the supporting passage.
- Find functions, inspect code, and explore symbol references.
- See which indexes your project has and how items relate.
- Save a new memory or a work checkpoint when you explicitly ask.
- Save a batch of documents you provide, without duplicates on retry.
- Reuse authorized project context across ChatGPT, Codex, and compatible MCP clients.
- Keep an optional conversation journal: short notes of what you asked or decided, so another chat can pick up the thread.
- Send a task to your own computer or another AI you registered as a Cube Bridge worker, follow its result, reply, cancel, or stop everything with the kill switch.

Sign in to Cube Memory and authorize a project to get started. Each connection is bound to one project. Results reflect the content available in that project; document and code indexes are snapshots and may need updating when their sources change. The conversation journal is off by default: it saves nothing until you ask to turn it on, and then keeps only a brief note of each exchange (never the full conversation) in your own project. You can turn it off at any time; notes already saved are kept. Cube Bridge tasks only reach workers that you installed and registered in your own project; nothing runs if you have no worker, and higher-risk tasks need a confirmation code that only you receive. Cube Memory cannot delete memories in bulk or reach other projects.

Data2Content watches your Reels, posts and carousels the way a person would: it listens to what you say, sees where you filmed, who shows up and what's on screen, and notices what your audience liked and commented on most.

With that, ChatGPT stops giving generic tips and starts answering about you: what you talk about, what could become a series and what people want to see from you.

A few examples of what to ask:

Ideas and scripts
A script starts from the way you already talk in your videos, not from a template.
• "O que eu posto hoje?" (What should I post today?)
• "Escreve um roteiro sobre ___ do meu jeito" (Write a script about ___ my way)
• "Esse roteiro tem a minha cara?" (Does this script sound like me?)

Understand your content
• "Do que eu falo que o público mais gosta?" (Which of my topics does my audience like most?)
• "O que eu faço nos vídeos que pode virar série?" (What do I do in my videos that could become a series?)
• "O que aparece nos meus posts que dão mais certo?" (What shows up in my best posts?)
• "Reels, carrossel ou post: o que funciona melhor pra mim?" (Reels, carousel or post: what works best for me?)
• "Acha aquele meu post sobre ___" (Find that post of mine about ___)

Look at other creators
Enter the @ of someone you admire or who covers the same topic. Data2Content shows which topics get the most engagement there, to inspire you without copying.
• "Analisa o @___: que assuntos engajam mais?" (Analyze @___: which topics get the most engagement?)
• "Compara meu perfil com o @___" (Compare my profile with @___)
• "O que está viralizando entre criadores do meu assunto?" (What's going viral among creators in my niche?)

Partnerships and brands
• "Tem publi aberta que combina comigo?" (Any open brand deals that fit me?)
• "Acha uma collab pra mim" (Find me a collab)

How to start
1. Tap Connect.
2. Sign in with your email and connect your Instagram.
3. Ask: "o que eu posto hoje?"

Data2Content does not post to Instagram, does not send mess

plugins.description:
Distill Markets gives ChatGPT direct access to US SEC filing data, served exactly as filed and traceable to the EDGAR accession that stated each number.

What it covers:
- Fundamentals from 10-K and 10-Q XBRL: latest values, up to 20 years of history, financial ratios, and a bring-your-own-price valuation panel.
- Point-in-time views: what was knowable on a past date, every version of a fact across filings, and material revisions, for restatement-aware research and backtests without lookahead.
- Ownership: 13F institutional holders and manager portfolios, Schedule 13D/13G blockholders, and Form 4 insider transactions.
- Filings and events: recent SEC filings, 8-K item events, and a delta feed for agent loops.
- Context: 16 government macro series and sector capital-cycle aggregates.
- Pre-2009 annual fundamentals parsed from text filings (FY1995 to FY2009), kept separate from the XBRL record and served with per-fact provenance.

Every tool is read-only. Responses carry the accession number, filing date and XBRL concept behind each value, so any figure can be checked against the SEC document. The server states no opinions and gives no investment advice: it reports what the filer said and how it reconciles.

Coverage is US domestic 10-K and 10-Q filers. Figures are in the filer's reporting currency, never converted.

A free account covers most tools. Analyst and Pro plans add depth: full ownership lists, point-in-time detail, cross-ticker comparison and the pre-2009 corpus.

Write a clear, engaging description that highlights what your plugin does and why people will love it. Focus on concrete user value and avoid exaggerative, misleading claims. This will appear publicly on your plugin’s directory page.
Connect ChatGPT directly to your Docs, so drafting and revising documents happens in the same place as the rest of your work: no copying text back and forth between a chat window and a browser tab.

Ask for a document by name and it searches your Drive to find it, then reads the contents back as clean markdown you can quote, summarize, translate or rework. Ask for something new and it creates the document and writes the first draft. From there you get real editing, not just appending: insert and replace text anywhere in the document, replace every occurrence of a phrase in one pass, restyle paragraphs and individual runs of text, and turn lists into proper bullets or strip them back out.

Tables are fully supported: create them, add or remove rows and columns, merge cells, style rows and cells, and pin header rows so they repeat across pages. So is the document furniture most tools skip: headers, footers, footnotes, page and section breaks, page layout settings, inline images, dates and people chips.

Every edit starts by inspecting the document's actual structure, so changes land in the right place instead of clobbering the surrounding text, and related changes are applied together as a single batch rather than one risky rewrite. Word files in your Drive work too: .docx is converted so it can be read and
edited like anything else.

It fits naturally into recurring document work: updating status reports, filling out templates, cleaning up formatting across a long file, and reworking a draft someone else started.

plugins.description:
doDomain is domain-connect-as-a-service: it gives a product a guided flow for pointing a customer's own domain at that product, and handles the DNS records, verification, and certificates behind it. The doDomain plugin lets ChatGPT drive that work from your account: check a domain's current DNS state, list the apps configured on your team, list existing domain connections, create a new connect session for a customer, look up a session you already started, verify a session once the records are in place, and re-run verification on a connection that has drifted.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration. Scopes are granted per capability on the consent screen — separate read and write scopes for domains, apps, connections, and sessions — and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant. Connected apps can be revoked at any time from the Connected Apps page in the dashboard. Tool responses are written against a narrow contract: secret API keys are never returned, and doDomain's billing surface is not reachable over the plugin at all.

Creating a connect session counts against your plan's monthly connection quota; verification checks are rate limited, so a repeated re-verify on the same connection will be told to wait rather than silently retried.

You already have a life. Build the one you want.

DREAMHALL is a private, structured self-care workspace for thinking through personal questions whose answers should remain your own. Instead of generating conclusions, it guides you through a complete process where you examine your life as a whole, develop your own answers, and turn them into grounded decisions and practical action.

The Framework consists of 15 connected exercises that help you understand what truly matters to you, review the balance of your life, separate your own wishes from outside expectations, clarify the future you want to build, work through fears and obstacles, and define realistic next steps.

Unlike an open-ended conversation, DREAMHALL is designed as a finite process with a clear beginning, a deliberate sequence, and a meaningful ending. Every answer is written by you. Every conclusion is your own. The result is a Personal Document that brings together your reflections, priorities, decisions, and next steps in one place.

Your private answers remain inside DREAMHALL and are not returned to ChatGPT through this integration.

When you finish, you can keep your Personal Document in DREAMHALL, download it as a PDF, or export it as Markdown. If you choose, you can later use your own document with ChatGPT to organize ideas, develop plans, compare future versions, or expand it into longer writing. You decide what to share and when.

DREAMHALL supports reflective thinking, life balance, personal wellbeing, and self-directed decision-making. It is a non-clinical self-care product and is not therapy, diagnosis, medical care, emergency support, or crisis support.

Some of the most important decisions should remain your own.

Play drums without leaving the chat. Tap the drum kit, make a beat, and let ChatGPT listen to what you played. It can tell you what went well, where you stayed on time, where you rushed or slowed down, and simple ways to get better. You do not need special gear or music skills to start. Open the app, play, and get feedback in the same conversation.

The drum kit lives right inside ChatGPT, so there is nothing extra to learn before you begin. Every hit is captured as you play. ChatGPT can look at your rhythm, timing, speed, and patterns instead of guessing from a description. That means the advice is based on what you actually played, not what you tried to explain. You can ask questions after every take, try again, and see how your playing changes over time.

This makes practice simple. Play a slow rock beat. Try a fast fill. Make up your own groove. Copy a rhythm you heard in a song. Then ask ChatGPT what it noticed. It can point out steady parts, missed beats, uneven spacing, and places where your hands could work together better. If something sounds good, it can explain why. If something feels hard, it can break the problem into small steps.

Beginners can use it to learn basic beats and build confidence. More experienced drummers can test ideas, explore different rhythms, or check how consistent their timing is. Teachers can use it to help students understand practice sessions. Parents can give children a fun way to explore music without needing a full drum set at home. Anyone who is curious about rhythm can jump in and start playing.

Because everything happens in one conversation, practice feels natural. You play, ChatGPT listens, you ask questions, and you get answers right away. There is no need to switch between different apps, upload recordings, or explain what happened. The performance is already there for ChatGPT to review. That keeps the focus on making music instead of managing files.

You can ask for different kinds of feedback too. Want a quick score?

plugins.description:
Duckhub QR Menu is restaurant software that digitizes dining with QR code menus and integrated ordering. Diners scan codes to view digital menus on their phones without apps or paper. An AI assistant generates dish descriptions, translates menus into 14 languages, and creates item images. Reservations are managed via the menu or apps like WhatsApp, with confirmations handled through a dashboard. Online ordering lets restaurants create websites with menus and ordering features. Table ordering allows diners to scan QR codes, select items, and send orders to the kitchen with table identification. Delivery management and staff access controls are included. Analytics track trends and peak hours, while customization options include templates, fonts, and logos. Smart promotions automate discounts based on times or days.

With this plugin, a restaurant owner connects their Duckhub venue to ChatGPT and manages it by conversation: read the current draft menu, create or edit categories, dishes, prices, ingredients and option groups, upload dish photos, translate the menu into any enabled language, adjust venue info, working hours, design and ordering settings, manage tables and their QR links, run promotions and banners, then publish the menu live (or roll a bad publish back). Paid plans can also read guest orders and move them through their lifecycle. Every change is scoped to the single venue the owner authorized, is written to a draft first, and only becomes visible to guests after an explicit publish.
plugins.author: Kostiantyn Zavgorodnii

plugins.description:
Check data against the standards, canonical models and policies it claims to conform to, and get back a graded, machine-readable result that says what was checked, what was not, and why.

dVeracity is a verification engine for regulated data. An agent can read a canonical data model at design time (entities, sectors, semantic codes and policy guardrails), validate a payload against a named standard before submitting it, look up approved regulatory compliance policies with their rules and provenance, and query verified datasets in natural language. Every result states its model version and the checks it ran, so it can be handed to a reviewer rather than pasted into a chat.

The first standard onboarded is Open Footprint (The Open Group), with O-DEF semantic codes, PACT product-footprint validation and verified emissions and methane datasets. The engine is domain-neutral; further standards are onboarded through the same path.

Eighteen tools, all read-only. Model, sector, semantic-code and standards-catalogue tools are free of charge. Natural-language queries and validation are metered per call in credits, with machine-readable HTTP 402 payment semantics: when an account runs out, the tool tells the agent to ask its human operator to top up, and never retries. Compliance-policy tools are available on paid plans.

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration; a human approves access on dVeracity's consent screen. Optional GLEIF-rooted vLEI verified-agent identity is supported for organisations that need attributable agents.

Built for compliance, ESG and reporting teams, standards implementers, and anyone whose data has to be checked before it is trusted.
plugins.author: dVeracity

EasyPDF edits the PDF files you share in the conversation, without leaving ChatGPT.

Attach a PDF and ask in plain language. EasyPDF can:
- Change, correct or delete text inside your PDF while keeping its original fonts, sizes, colors and layout (a date, an amount, a name, a typo, a line in a CV or an invoice)
- Compress a PDF to shrink its size (three quality levels)
- Merge several PDFs into one, in the order you choose
- Split a PDF into parts, or extract only the pages you need
- Rotate all pages or selected pages
- Protect a PDF with a password, or remove a password you know
- Add page numbers at the position you want

After a text edit, a preview shows the changed page before and after, with the status of each change.

Every result comes back as a download link that stays valid for one hour. Files are processed on EasyPDF servers and deleted automatically; nothing is kept beyond that hour and no account is needed.

Typical requests:
"In this invoice, change the due date to 31/10/2026"
"Fix the typo in my CV and update my phone number"
"Compress this PDF so I can email it"
"Merge these three PDFs in this order"
"Extract pages 2 to 5 from this document"

EasyPDF is built by the team behind easypdf.fr, a PDF editor available in 13 languages.

plugins.name: app-6a48cc28fd6881918b950cd57bc7fd2a
plugins.description:
Der ecoExperten-Connector bringt den deutschen Energieausweis in den KI-Chat. Wer eine Wohnimmobilie vermieten oder verkaufen will, braucht gesetzlich einen Energieausweis — mit dieser App lässt er sich vollständig im Gespräch bestellen:

1. Beraten: Die App erklärt, welcher Ausweistyp passt und welche Angaben nötig sind (Gebäudedaten plus drei aufeinanderfolgende Jahres-Heizabrechnungen).
2. Prüfen: Alle Angaben werden vorab kostenlos gegen die gesetzlichen Regeln des Gebäudeenergiegesetzes (GEG) validiert — z. B. 18-Monats-Frist der Verbrauchsdaten, Bedarfsausweis-Pflicht nach § 80 Abs. 3, Leerstandsgrenzen — ohne dass eine Bestellung ausgelöst wird.
3. Bestellen: Nach ausdrücklicher Zustimmung zu AGB und zahlungspflichtiger Bestellung legt die App eine schwebende Bestellung an und sendet einen Bestätigungslink an die angegebene E-Mail-Adresse. Erst der Klick auf diesen Link macht die Bestellung verbindlich; unbestätigte Bestellungen verfallen nach 48 Stunden automatisch. Kauf auf Rechnung, kein Zahlungsvorgang im Chat. Ein Doppelbestellungs-Schutz verhindert versehentliche Mehrfachkäufe.
4. Verfolgen: Der Bearbeitungsstand ist über Bestellnummer plus die bei der Bestellung angegebene E-Mail-Adresse abrufbar; die Antwort enthält nur den Bearbeitungsstand, keine Personen- oder Gebäudedaten.

Die Ausstellung erfolgt durch eingetragene Energieberater des CO5 Ingenieurbüros für nachhaltiges Bauen (PartG mbB, Berlin); jeder Ausweis erhält eine amtliche DIBt-Registriernummer und wird in der Regel innerhalb von 1–2 Werktagen als PDF per E-Mail zugestellt. Preis: 59 € brutto (Verbrauchsausweis); der Bedarfsausweis (119 €) ist über das Web-Formular erhältlich.

plugins.description:
EnergyIA.AR connects ChatGPT to Argentine energy and mining data taken from official public sources (the energy and mining secretariats, CAMMESA, ENARGAS, INDEC, customs, official gazettes), normalized and up to date.

What you can ask:
- Oil and gas: production by field, basin, formation, province, operator and well; Vaca Muerta area by area; well performance, trajectories and status; drilling and fracking; reserves and upstream investment.
- Refining: the crude each refinery processes and where it comes from.
- Emissions: the official greenhouse-gas inventory, gas flaring and the footprint of producing oil and gas.
- Mining: projects, production and exports by mineral and province.
- Electricity: installed capacity, generation, demand and large consumers.
- Gas network and consumption, the oil value chain and pump prices.
- Energy trade: exports by port and destination, export prices by company, daily gas and crude at the borders, and vessels.
- RIGI investment projects, public tenders and opportunities for suppliers.
- Vigía: status, timeline and figures of key projects; concepts, guides and sector history.

Every answer carries its source, its period and its unit. Use Deep Dive to ask broader investigative questions and return evidence-backed results, once the Deep Dive tools are available.

Convert a natural-language request into a structured Everlaw search. 

Generate structured reports about project contents, document volumes, custodians, dates, Bates ranges, and other returned data.

The Evernote MCP server connects your Evernote account to your AI tools, so they can work from the notes, documents, and files you've already collected. Search across years of captured material, edit and organize what's there, and file new work straight back into your notebooks.

Key features:
• Search by keyword or by meaning - Use Evernote's search grammar to filter by notebook, tag, and date, or search semantically to surface notes by what they're about, even when you can't remember the words you used.
• Find what you never typed - Search reaches text inside scanned documents, photos, and images, and inside transcribed audio and video — so handwritten pages, whiteboard shots, receipts, and recorded meetings are all searchable alongside your written notes. Attached files can be downloaded and new ones uploaded.
• Read, write, and edit real notes - Fetch a note's full content, tags, and attachments; create new notes in the right notebook; update titles and bodies; and restore anything that ends up in the trash.
• Keep your account organized - Move notes between notebooks, add and remove tags, rename and re-parent tags, and create notebooks and Spaces as your work grows.
• Manage tasks inside your notes - Create tasks, update status and due dates, and find the ones you own or have been assigned, filtered by priority.
Everything happens inside your own account, under your existing permissions.

plugins.description:
ExpenseOS turns a conversation into a finished expense report.

Drop receipts into chat as photos, PDFs, or plain descriptions and ExpenseOS keeps a running list: merchant, date, category, and amount, organized by month or trip. Describe a drive ("office to the Hartford client and back") and ExpenseOS figures out the actual driving distance and applies the current IRS mileage rate, including the mid-year rate changes your spreadsheet missed.

When you're ready, ExpenseOS puts everything into a polished PDF report, plus files your finance team can open straight in Excel or QuickBooks. It double-checks every line for the things that get reports bounced back: missing details, forgotten attendees, duplicate charges. Then it sends the report to your approver with a one-click review link. No account or app needed on their end. After you send it, ExpenseOS tracks where your report stands (pending, approved, or rejected) and counts how many days you've been waiting, so asking "how much am I owed?" always has a real answer.

Use it for:

• Turning receipt photos and PDFs into organized expenses
• Logging business mileage at the current IRS mileage rate
• Building expense reports as PDF, Excel, or QuickBooks-ready files
• Sending expense reports to your manager for one-click approval
• Tracking approval status and how long you've been owed

Try: "File my expenses from this trip" - "Log my drive to the client site and back" - "Make my expense report and submit it to my manager" - "How much am I owed?"

From a pocketful of receipts to a submitted, tracked expense report, without ever leaving the conversation.
plugins.author: ExpenseOS

- Whether a company still exists, and under which name a company with a former name is registered today.
- Listings that business owners maintain themselves, with their short description, website and public phone number.

Where the data comes from
Swiss entries come from Zefix, the central business name index of the Federal Commercial Registry Office (EHRA). Austrian entries come from the Firmenbuch, published as open data by the Republic of Austria, represented by the Federal Ministry of Justice (CC BY 4.0). Every answer names its source. The plugin returns active companies only.

What it does not do
It does not search for persons, gives no contact details for register entries, keeps no lists of insolvencies or deletions, and gives no credit information. It is a private directory, not the official register, and its data has no legal effect. For a certified extract use zefix.admin.ch or JustizOnline.

How results are ordered
Name match first, then listings maintained by the owner, then rating (from three reviews), then name. Paid plans on FIRMEN.directory have no influence on inclusion, order or presentation, and the plugin shows no advertising.

No account is needed and the plugin is free. Each result links to the company's profile on FIRMEN.directory. Answers are in your language; company data and source lines are German.

FlightSeatMap turns "which seat should I pick?" into a question your assistant can actually answer.

Give it a flight number and it returns the real cabin layout: every row, every seat, the cabin classes, and which seats are still free. Ask for a window seat with extra legroom away from the galley and it ranks the available seats against those preferences, then shows the result on an interactive seat map you can click through. Ask about one specific seat and it tells you the pitch, the recline, whether there is a power socket, how close the lavatory is, and what other travellers thought of it.

The tools:

- get_seatmap returns the stored seat map for a flight.
- find_best_seats ranks the free seats against preferences such as window, aisle, exit row, extra legroom or quiet zone.
- get_seat_info returns the full detail on one seat.
- interactive_seat_finder is the starting point when the traveller has not said what they want yet.
- get_seat_reviews returns traveller reviews, with ratings and per-seat comments.
- discover_more_flight_tools lists related flight and travel MCP servers.
- search_flight fetches current data for a flight that is not stored yet.
- create_seat_alert emails the traveller when a matching seat frees up.
- list_seat_alerts and delete_seat_alert manage those alerts.

Seat map, review and alert results render as interactive components inside the conversation, so the traveller can click a seat instead of reading a table.

The data covers 117 airlines and 846 aircraft seat maps.

Forms are easy to need and annoying to build. Every question type, every section break, every setting is another click - and by the time responses arrive, reading them is its own chore. This plugin moves all of it into the conversation.

Build a form by describing it. Say what you're collecting — a customer satisfaction survey, an event signup, a job application screener, a 20-point quiz for your class — and it's created in your account, with sensible question types chosen for you: multiple choice where the answers are known, scales for ratings, short text where they aren't, required fields where they matter.

Keep editing in plain language. Add a question in the middle. Reword the confusing one. Move it to page two. Make question 4 worth double. Drop the one nobody answers. Every change lands on the live form — no rebuilding from scratch, no digging through the editor to find the right toggle.

Set it up properly, without hunting for settings. Turn a form into a graded quiz, collect email addresses, limit it to one response per person, open or close it to responses - all by asking.

Then actually read the results. Find any of your forms by name, pull the responses, and ask real questions of them: What's the overall sentiment? What are the three most common complaints in the open-text box? How did answers differ between the two groups? Free-text feedback - the part that usually goes unread because summarizing 200 answers by hand isn't happening - gets read and summarized for you.

Works with the forms you already own, not just new ones.

plugins.description:
Ask about your product analytics, and get answers you can verify.

Fullstory MCP connects Codex and ChatGPT to your product's behavioral data. Ask how many users adopted a feature, where checkout is leaking, or whether yesterday's release broke something, and Codex and ChatGPT builds the segment, computes the metric, and explains the result with a link back to Fullstory.

Analytics connectors can give you numbers. Fullstory shows you what happened. Metrics unpack into real session replay, so "conversion dropped 12%" becomes "the coupon field errors for logged-out users."

And because Fullstory autocaptures clicks, page views, errors, and frustration signals, many questions need no instrumentation at all. Ask about rage clicks on pricing or errors in checkout without shipping a single event.

What Codex and ChatGPT can do:
(1) Build and save segments and metrics.
Describe the users or behavior you care about in your own words; Codex and ChatGPT create segments or metrics in Fullstory where your whole team can reuse it.

(2) Compute on demand.
 Counts, rates, trends, and breakdowns by device, browser, geography, or user property, over any time window.

(3) Speak your product's language. 
Codex and ChatGPT discover your pages, named elements, and defined events, so questions map to your real product vocabulary instead of guessed selectors.

(4) Analyze conversion.
Read your saved funnels and measure where users drop and why.

(5) Back every number with sessions.
Retrieve the sessions and events behind any metric, including frustration signals like rage clicks and dead clicks.

(6) Read sessions at scale.
Ask Codex and ChatGPT to review dozens of sessions behind a drop-off or an alert and report the patterns, including failures that never reached your error tracker.

Teams use it to let PMs, support, and engineers self-serve answers that used to queue behind an analyst, and to settle "why did this number move?" with evidence instead of theories.
plugins.author: Fullstory

plugins.description:
GadgetOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi phone, laptop and electronics shop runs on — point of sale, stock by IMEI and serial number, a warranty and repair desk, suppliers, and VAT-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one shop a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold this month and get the real figure. Ask what is running out and get the items below their reorder level with a suggested quantity. Ask about one IMEI and get that exact handset: in stock or sold, its cost and its price, when it arrived and when it left, and the warranty left on it. Ask what is on the repair desk and get every claim with its status, customer, device, days open and estimate. Ask whether a customer's phone is still under warranty and get the determination from the sale date — or, where no warranty period was ever recorded, that fact stated plainly instead of a guess.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a device, change a price, a rack location or a reorder level, receive stock or one serialized unit, log an expense, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, book a device in for repair, and move a claim along to inspecting, estimate pending, approved, repairing, ready or delivered.

It searches a shared reference catalog of phones, laptops and accessories, so adding a product inherits the right brand, category, specifications and official image rather than starting from a blank row.

Everything is scoped to the single shop the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data.

Rejecting or refunding a warranty claim needs a manager PIN, and there is no tool for it — that stays in the app on purpose.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

plugins.description:
You know the problem. A deadline slips, another fire drill ensues, and it turns out the team knew weeks ago. The information was there. An easy channel for surfacing it wasn't.

Conventional status reporting is painful and often inaccurate as reports get sanitized on the way up. By the time a project is obviously red, the good options have gone.

Genchi opens a different channel, straight to the people actually doing the work. Team members are prompted for a regular two-second check-in: one click, answering how confident they are their initiative will hit its goal by the deadline. Individual answers are anonymous, which is what makes them honest. Aggregated, they become a confidence score you can track over time.

This plugin puts that score into the conversation, rendered rather than described. Ask how your projects are tracking and your whole portfolio appears as color-coded cards. More complex project structures unfurl with a click, and clicking any card opens the confidence chart — the current score, the trend over the last fortnight, the anonymized individual check-ins, and any blockers or comments that add context.

Things rarely go wrong all at once. Seeing a team's confidence begin to slip is an opportunity to intervene while there is still time to change the outcome.

Replace the status meeting, and the incessant "so, how's it going?" calls, with a crisp and honest view.

Inspired by the Toyota Production System's genchi genbutsu — "go and see for yourself" — Genchi does the same for software teams: a picture built by the people actually doing the work, at minimal reporting cost.

Each connection is authorized by one person and shows only what they can already see in Genchi. Individual check-ins are never attributed. Check-ins are cast in Slack, or by email.

Genchi also imports initiatives from Jira and Asana, and is free for teams under 10.

plugins.description:
Glow is WordPress maintenance and management software for agencies: updates, uptime and SSL monitoring, backups, vulnerability scanning, client reporting and support tickets, for every site an agency looks after, in one dashboard.

A vulnerability is published most weeks and the first question is the same: which of my sites are exposed? Answering that across forty sites means opening forty dashboards, so it does not get answered until something breaks. Connected to Glow it is one question with one answer, and the follow-up (update those, safely) happens in the same conversation.

What you can ask: which sites run a plugin below a given version; what needs updating on a particular site; which sites a newly published vulnerability affects; which went down this month and which certificates expire soon; which have no recent backup or no scheduled report; and which clients are over their monthly time allowance.

What it can change, each behind its own permission, granted deliberately and none of them required: run updates, where plugins go through Safe Updates with a backup and screenshot first, a check afterwards and a rollback if needed, while themes and WordPress core are not reversible, which the tool says plainly before running one; turn uptime monitoring on or off for a website; and log work against a website and set its monthly time allowance.

What it can never do: delete a website, a backup or a client, or deactivate a plugin, a theme or anything on a client's website. Those are not exposed to assistants at all.

A connection sees exactly what the person who authorised it sees, including any per-website restrictions, and never receives passwords, connection keys or website content. Every request is logged, and a connection can be ended at any time.

For WordPress agencies, freelancers and reseller accounts looking after many client sites.

plugins.description:
GovQuery is a powerful search engine that makes U.S. government reports and data easier to explore, locate, and understand.
 
Built by the Program Integrity Alliance, GovQuery processes over 300,000 articles, reports, and oversight recommendations to make them more digestible for AI platforms — offering deeper, more targeted search than general-purpose engines. Every result links to the exact page where content appears, and you can filter by granular categories unavailable on the source platforms.
 
Data sources currently include:
 
- Reports from the Government Accountability Office (GAO), federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), and the Congressional Research Service (CRS)
- Department of Justice press releases
- Executive orders (last six presidents)
- Annual federal CJ/AFR/PAR agency reports (since 2019 for Chief Financial Officers (CFO) Act of 1990)
 
GovQuery also includes all open oversight recommendations from the GAO and federal inspectors general (Oversight.gov), with tools to analyze them by category and track trends over time.
 
New data sources are added regularly.
 
You can register for a free account at: https://www.programintegrity.org (click on the person icon top-right)

For more information on GovQuery data, please see our FAQ (https://www.programintegrity.org/faq).

You can start with one color, two colors, a mood, a brand, or even a simple sentence. The GPT turns your idea into well-balanced gradient suggestions and explains why they work in clear, simple language.

It can create linear, radial, and other common gradient styles. If you already have colors, it can improve them. If you only have an idea, it can suggest colors from scratch. If something feels “off,” it can recommend small changes that make the whole design look better.

This GPT is useful for designers, developers, marketers, students, creators, hobbyists, and anyone who wants better-looking colors without spending hours experimenting.

• A colorful gaming theme.
• A luxury black and gold look.

• A nature-inspired palette.
• A dark mode background.
• A hero section gradient.
• A gradient based on your company colors.

If you are building a website, the GPT can suggest gradients that feel clean, readable, and professional. If you are making an app, it can recommend combinations that support the style you want. Heliciel turns your AI assistant into a propeller and turbine design engineer. Instead of plausible-looking guesses, every number comes from a real BEM (Blade Element Momentum) computation run by the Heliciel engineering software — the same solver used by hobbyists and professionals for 15+ years.

What you can design: aircraft propellers, drone/multirotor propellers, marine propellers, axial fans, wind turbines, hydro turbines (including ducted Kaplan runners), wings and hydrofoils.

What the AI can do with it:
- Size a propeller from your specification (power, speed, thrust, diameter, blade count) — the design RPM is searched automatically to hit your target.
- Analyze off-design behaviour: operating-point performance, sweep curves (power vs wind speed, efficiency vs RPM), 2D performance maps.
- Optimize: RPM, blade count, tip radius, chord distribution — iterative or genetic search, always within bounds you choose.
- Check physics: cavitation (marine), noise indicators, blade stress warnings, hydraulic head balance for ducted turbines.
- Show results: interactive 3D viewer embedded in the conversation (rotate the blade, pick an element, read its profile), performance charts, design alerts.
- Export for manufacturing: STL (3D printing/CFD), IGES (CAD), OBJ, blade sections (JSON), analysis tables (CSV).

Honest by design: the server refuses to invent values. Missing parameters are asked, not assumed; inherited model values are flagged; failed computations are reported as-is with Heliciel's own design alerts.

Requirements: an existing Heliciel MCP pass. Sign in with OAuth: your pass key is your credential — no account, no password to create.

Most analytics tools consume credits from your Homesage.ai account, and each tool's credit cost is listed in its description. The property database search always previews the result count and cost for free before charging.

Homesage.ai reads property data and returns analysis. It does not modify your account, move funds, or take actions on your behalf. Coverage is US residential properties only, and comparable-sale and ARV data is limited in non-disclosure states where sale prices aren't public.

【日本語】
HotelMEで、九州ふっこう割の対象プランと日本各地のホテルを探せます。公式予約サイトで確認できた対象プランの参考料金、割引条件、公式予約リンクを案内します。Metroアカウントの作成・ログインは不要です。ChatGPT側の利用条件は別途適用されます。

九州ふっこう割の検索は、大人1〜5名・1室1泊に対応しています。行き先、宿泊日、大人人数を伝えてください。不足する条件は会話や対応画面のフォームで確認できます。料金は指定した大人全員の1室1泊合計です。公式サイトに表示された割引後料金と、割引規則から算出した「計算値・目安」を区別し、クーポン取得・入力、現地での割引、後日返金などの必要な手続きも案内します。計算値は確定料金ではなく、宿の端数処理により最大99円高くなる場合があります。

対象期間・受付状況・予算は県や宿泊日によって異なり、受付終了や未確認の場合もあります。子ども料金、複数室・連泊全体の空室と総額は確認できません。そのようなご希望には、対応できる場合、大人のみ・1室1泊へ条件を調整した参考情報を、変更点とともに案内します。対応する予約先では日付や人数をリンクへ引き継ぎますが、予約先で条件や対象プランを選び直す場合もあります。

通常のホテル検索では、エリア・クチコミの分析テーマ・参考料金をもとに候補を探し、最大3施設を比較できます。食事・客室・接客などのクチコミ集計と分析を提供し、個別のクチコミ本文は提供しません。通常料金の比較は大人2名・1室・子どもなし、1〜14泊に対応しています。ふっこう割検索とは対応条件が異なります。

情報がない施設・日付・条件もあります。料金や対象プランの情報は、現在の空室・割引の適用・予約成立を保証しません。最新の料金、空室、人数、税金、割引条件は予約先でご確認ください。予約・支払いは外部の予約サイトで行い、HotelMEは予約手続きを行いません。お問い合わせはHotelMEサポートフォームをご利用ください。

【English】
Find Kyushu Fukko campaign plans and hotels across Japan with HotelME. Explore reference prices, discount requirements and official booking links for campaign plans found on hotel booking sites. No Metro account or login is required. ChatGPT's own access requirements still apply.

Kyushu campaign searches support 1–5 adults, one room and one night. Tell HotelME your destination, stay date and number of adults. Missing details can be collected in the conversation or a form on supported screens. Prices are the total for the specified adults in one room for one night. HotelME distinguishes discounts shown by the booking site from calculated estimates, and explains required coupon steps, on-site discounts or later refunds. Estimates are not final quotes; the hotel's rounding may make the amount up to JPY 99 higher.

Eligible periods, applications and remaining budgets vary by prefecture and stay date, and may be closed or unconfirmed. Child prices and availability or totals for a complete multi-room or multi-night stay are not supported. Where possible, these requests can receive an adult-only, one-room, one-night reference sea
