plugins.name: hubity
plugins.description:
Hubity runs projects, time, billing and utilization for consulting, architecture, engineering and agency firms. Connect ChatGPT to Hubity and ask in plain words, and the answer comes from your own records.

Start with the month's billing. Ask ChatGPT to bill last month and it shows you each invoice first: approved time, expenses, the retainer fee and progress billing against the contract, with money held back (retainage) where the project sets it, and anything that needs your decision called out. Confirm, and it drafts them. Nothing is sent: every draft is marked as drafted by your assistant and waits in Hubity for a person to review and send it.

It also reports utilization, project profitability, and cash flow including the value of unbilled time.

Try:
- "Bill last month: show me what each invoice would be first."
- "Which active projects are at risk, and are they profitable?"
- "What is the longest-open unpaid invoice?"
- "What is our WIP for last month?"
- "Who was over capacity last month?"

ChatGPT can also reach projects and tasks, the team and who reports to whom, deals, proposals, invoices, meetings, time off and the knowledge base, with ready-made prompts for firm jobs: bill the month, month-end WIP, collections, who's over capacity, projects losing money, and a standup.

Reading needs your sign-in and approval and follows your role; drafting invoices or logging time needs write access you approve, and every change is audited.
- You approve each connection on a Hubity consent screen that names the app, shows where it will send you back, and lists what it can do.
- Sensitive documents are left out, private staff details are excluded by role, and data is kept separate per company.
- With write access, ChatGPT can draft the month's invoices for your review, log time, and turn an accepted proposal into a draft invoice. It never sends anything to a client. Each change is tied to the person who approved access.

plugins.description:
Need to know if a website is down? Type its address and I’ll check it for you. 

I quickly test if the site can be reached and tell you what I find in clear, simple words. If the site is working, I’ll say it is online. If it is not working, I’ll explain that too. You do not need special computer skills. Just ask, and I’ll do the checking.

This is helpful when a page will not load, an app will not connect, or a service seems broken. Many problems look the same, but they can have different causes. A website may be down for everyone. It may only be blocked for you. Your internet may have a problem. The site may be slow. I help you understand what is most likely happening so you know what to try next.

Using me is easy. Tell me the website you want to check. You can paste a full web address or simply type the name of the site. I will test whether it can be reached and share the result in plain English. If there is useful extra information, I will explain what it means without lots of hard words.

You can check almost any public website. News sites, shops, games, schools, blogs, company pages, and online tools can all be checked. If a page is public on the internet, I can usually test whether it is responding. If a site cannot be checked for a technical reason, I will tell you instead of guessing.

If a website is online, I can help you think about why it still is not working for you. Maybe your browser needs to refresh. Maybe your internet connection has a problem. Maybe a VPN, firewall, or network setting is getting in the way. Sometimes waiting a few minutes is enough because a busy service starts working again.

If a website is down, I explain that in a simple way. I will not make up reasons or pretend to know something I cannot see. If there is not enough information, I will say so. Clear answers are better than confusing ones.

This tool is useful for everyone. Students can check school websites before class. Families can see if a favorite game or video site is ha

Things you can ask:
• "What's the current macro regime?"
• "What does this week's read mean for a portfolio with BTC, AAPL and GLD?"
• "Is my thesis on this position still intact?"
• "What's in this week's World Brief?"

Every answer ends with its sources and how fresh they are, so you can see exactly where each number came from and when it was last updated. The framework itself is public and versioned, with a changelog that says what changed and why, including the times it changed because it was wrong.

Jawz is free and needs no account. The market and portfolio tools work the moment you connect. An optional email sign-in exists only to remember your settings between sessions.

One thing Jawz deliberately will not do is tell you what to buy or sell. It shows what is true about the market and your positions, frames the decision, and leaves the decision to you. Jawz is information and framework, not investment advice.

JobMojito runs AI-led conversational sessions in three shapes: scored interviews for hiring, simulated personas that assess how someone handles a real situation, and self-serve coaching for practice. Connect this server and your assistant can set all three up, invite people, and read back transcripts, scores and reports — as you, with your own permissions.

Interviews. Generate one from a job description, or supply your own questions. Pick the modality: a voice-only interviewer, a live video avatar, or a pre-recorded one. Register candidates and each gets a personal link; when they finish you get the transcript, structured analysis and a shareable HTML or PDF report.

Simulated personas. Instead of a question list, the avatar plays a defined character in free-form conversation — a sceptical buyer, an angry customer, a difficult stakeholder — and the person is scored on how they handle it. These use the same invitation and result flow as an interview, so they land in the recruiter's result list alongside everything else.

Coaching. The same persona engine pointed at practice rather than assessment: learners start sessions themselves from a browsable catalogue, spend their own coaching credits, and their results stay private from recruiters. Organise the catalogue with directories, tag filters and your own Markdown pages.

Across all three: upload documents to a knowledge base the AI draws on, check credits and analytics, and search JobMojito's documentation without leaving the conversation. If you manage several accounts — an agency, a reseller, sub-brands — an interactive picker chooses which merchant you are acting as.

Everything JobMojito produces is decision support: input for a qualified human reviewer, never a hiring decision on its own, and candidates are told AI is part of the process. Read-only lookups run freely; anything that creates a session, mints a link or generates a report asks you first.

plugins.name: app-6a91a85bf4a08191af8367df88e7f0c8
plugins.description:
Keenable SELECT answers a research question with one query instead of ten page reads.

Ordinary web search hands the model a list of links and leaves the reading, the extraction and the de-duplication to it. SELECT does that work inside the search. The model writes one read-only SQL statement in a DuckDB dialect; the server runs the searches in parallel, fetches the pages, pulls out the fields the query asks for with a per-row model call, removes duplicates, and returns a table.

One query can cover more than a thousand pages, filter them with ordinary SQL at no extra cost, and group them into the answer. The rows arrive as a table, not as a wall of page text, so the answer is grounded in a lot more sources than the context could hold.

Every result is saved as a result set for 30 days, so the next question can be asked of the same pages without searching again. A finished table can be published as a single HTML report, charts and all, at a link you can hand to someone.

Use it for a survey, a comparison or a ranking across many sources. It is not the tool for a quick look at one page: a query runs from seconds to minutes, because it really does search, fetch and read.

Connect your Keenable account once to enable it. Searching and fetching bill that account.
plugins.author: Keenable.ai

Every AI you talk to has amnesia, and a wall around it. You re-explain the same context to each one, every session, and none of them share what they learn.

Kemory is a permissioned memory that lives across every AI you use. Tell one thing to one assistant and they all understand, with you holding the keys. Connect it to ChatGPT and your preferences, project facts and decisions are there from the first message — including the ones you explained last week, in a different client, on a different machine.

This is not another memory inside one assistant. ChatGPT remembers what you tell ChatGPT. Kemory is the layer underneath that travels with you: the same memory answers in ChatGPT, in Codex, in Claude, in Cursor, and in any other MCP client — with organisation-level scoping and an audit trail that a single assistant's memory does not provide.

What you can do with it:

- Recall decisions, preferences and context from earlier conversations, without repeating them
- Keep project knowledge in one place and draw on it across ChatGPT, Codex, Claude, Cursor and any other MCP client
- Carry a thread from one AI into another without losing where you were
- Inspect everything Kemory holds about you, and delete any of it

How it is governed: every memory is scoped to a user and an organisation, and that scoping is enforced in the database rather than in a prompt. Colleagues cannot read each other's memories by default.
Memories are shared only when you deliberately promote them to a shared namespace, and every event lands in a hash-chained, tamper-evident audit log. We do not train on your data.

Kemory reads only what you deliberately capture into your own account. It never reads ChatGPT's own memory, chat history, conversation summaries or your files.

Kemory reads and writes. Every memory tool is titled and annotated, so ChatGPT knows reading from writing from deleting before it runs anything.

LawQi is not a legal AI tool and does not provide legal advice. It does not answer substantive legal questions, perform case-law or statutory research, or draft documents.

What LawQi answers
In scope — the practice of using AI in legal work:

Prompting technique, and what makes a prompt produce usable work
Verifying AI output and catching hallucinations
Disclosure and confidentiality obligations when using AI on client matters
The duty of technological competence
Choosing and evaluating AI tools
The ethics of AI use in a practice

Out of scope, and deliberately so:

Substantive legal questions — what the law is, or how it applies to a situation
Case-law and statutory research
Drafting documents, or reviewing ones you are drafting
Anything that would amount to legal adv

plugins.description:
Letsfind creates group polls from a description in the chat. Say which dates you want to propose, or which options people should choose between, and you get back a link to share.

There are two kinds of polls. A date poll proposes several days or time slots and asks everyone what works for them, which is the usual way to settle on a meeting, a dinner or a trip. An options poll asks a plain question with answers you define, for picking a restaurant, a name or a plan.

Every poll comes back with two links. The voting link is the one you send to the group; people open it in a browser and answer without creating an account or installing anything. The admin link is yours alone and the only way to edit the poll later, so it is worth keeping.

Once answers come in, you can ask here how the poll is doing instead of opening it yourself. You get the count for each option and the names of the people who picked it.
plugins.author: Samuel Schaffranek

plugins.name: app-6a9f12de5b508191b079837167196c31
plugins.description:
Plan a trip with the assistant you already talk to, and it turns into a real trip in LetsPackUp: organized, and ready to share with the people you are travelling with.

Ask for a week in Portugal with three friends, and the assistant lays it out in LetsPackUp the way a trip should be laid out. Days in order, with times. Every stop on the map. A packing list. A place to note who paid for what, so the money is fair without anyone doing the sums. Then you share it, and it is one trip for everyone, not a chat thread of screenshots.

What your friends and family see when you share it
- The plan, day by day, with the times and the places.
- Every stop on a map, with notes for each one.
- The packing list, so nobody forgets the charger.
- Who paid what and who owes whom, worked out for the group.
- A calendar to find the dates everyone can make.
- A group chat and polls to settle the open questions.
- An idea box where anyone can propose an afternoon, a restaurant or a whole day, and the group votes.

Everyone you invite opens the same trip on the web or on Android, and it works without a connection once it is loaded. Whatever anyone adds, the whole group sees.

How the assistant fits in
The assistant works only in the trips you choose and does only what you allow: looking at the plan, adding to it, creating trips, or also deleting things, reading the chat, posting to it, and creating share links for trips you own. You decide once, you can change your mind at any time, and you can switch the assistant off with one click. Everything it adds appears under your name, and the group can edit it, vote on it or take it out.

What stays yours
The assistant never changes what your co-travellers wrote. It never sees their email addresses, their location, their files or their emergency contacts, and it never sees where anyone actually is. It cannot remove anyone from a trip, and it cannot delete a trip you created yourself.

LetsPackUp is free, and so is using it with your assistant.

plugins.description:
Assistants get Lithuanian law wrong in a repeatable way: statute text on the web carries no date, so an answer about "article 52 of the Labour Code" is confidently right for some year and wrong for the one you are in.

Every answer here is for one point in time. It carries the validity window of the consolidated edition the words came from, and a URL on the official register where the same words and the same dates can be checked. Ten tools cover reading an article on a date, comparing two dates, listing which provisions changed between them, checking whether a citation made in an old document still holds, and listing amendments that are adopted but not yet in force.

When the register cannot confirm a point - a gap in the edition timeline, an act outside the curated catalogue of about 581 base acts, data too stale to stand behind - it says so and gives the reason. It does not guess. A refusal is never billed.

Data is published by the Chancellery of the Seimas and the State Data Agency under CC BY 4.0; the attribution travels in every response. This is published legislation, not legal advice.

plugins.name: liu-cards
plugins.description:
Liu Cards is a flashcards app with spaced repetition. This plugin connects your assistant to your own Liu Cards deck, so you can build cards and study without leaving the conversation.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

- Turn a conversation into cards. Ask for flashcards on whatever you have just been discussing. Candidates are checked against your deck first, so you do not pile up duplicates.
- Learn vocabulary properly. The server lays out a vocabulary card for you: the word with its pronunciation and part of speech on the front, and the meaning, an example sentence and its translation on the back. The word and the example are spoken aloud.
- Review out loud. Ask to be quizzed, answer from memory, and every result is recorded. An FSRS scheduler decides when each card comes back, just before you would forget it.
- See what you already know. Ask what you know about a subject and get back the related cards, each with a mastery label: new, learning, shaky or known.
- Add pictures. Put a photo from the chat, or an image from the web, on either side of a card. A side with a picture needs no text, which suits "who or what is this?" cards.
- Follow channels. Browse public collections of ready-made cards, save the ones you want into your own deck, or post to a channel you own.

WHAT YOU NEED

A Liu Cards account. You sign in and approve the connection on liucards.app, and you can disconnect it whenever you like. Cards you create are private to you unless you post them to a public channel.

Liu Cards runs in any browser at liucards.app and as an app on iPhone and Android, so everything you make here is waiting for you wherever you study.

plugins.description:
Get mortgage numbers from Loan Factory, Inc. (NMLS #320841), a licensed mortgage broker, priced off today's lender rate sheets.
Ask what a loan would cost you and get current options with the note rate, APR, monthly principal and interest, mortgage insurance where it applies, and estimated closing costs. Check whether a loan is conforming or jumbo in a county and what the FHA limit is. You do not need a ZIP code: give a city and state and it finds the county.
Work out how much home you can afford on your income and debts, a monthly payment with taxes and insurance, whether a refinance pays off and when it breaks even, and whether buying beats renting over the years you plan to stay. Look up plain definitions of mortgage terms.
Give a US property address to get public-record facts: property type, size, lot, year built, last sale, assessed value, tax and, where available, an estimated value range. Owner names and contact details are never returned.
Ask to be emailed when rates reach a target. Loan Factory emails the address to confirm the alert, with links to change or stop it, and you can stop alerts started from this app at any time.
Answer with whatever you know. If you leave something out, a representative figure is used and reported back, so you can see what the numbers rest on and correct it. Figures are estimates, not loan offers or locked rates. Loan Factory does not pull credit, approve loans or take applications here, and rates are available only where it is licensed. No account or sign-up is required.

• Create and update projects, clients, tasks and documents, and leave comments on tasks. It can never delete anything.

Every answer links back to the record in Loopsii, so what ChatGPT made or changed is one click away.

Sign-in is standard OAuth: you see which app is asking and exactly what it may do — read your workspace, and create and update records. Access tokens expire after an hour and renew silently, and you can disconnect at any time in Loopsii → Settings → API → Connected apps.

Loopsii never sees your conversation with ChatGPT; it only receives the tool requests ChatGPT makes and returns the matching records. Bank details are never readable or editable through the plugin. Setup guide: loopsii.com/connect/chatgpt.

plugins.description:
Pick a target LSAT score by guessing, and you find out what the school's last class scored after you've applied.

Ask this connector what a law school's class scored and you get the 25th, median, and 75th percentile LSAT and GPA, for 196 schools, with the source next to each number. Ask what the school costs and you get its ABA 509 numbers: acceptance rate, tuition, the share of students who got a grant, the median grant, and the first-time bar passage rate, each with the year it was filed. Give it your LSAT score and it lists the schools where that score sits at or above the 75th percentile, the median, or the 25th percentile.

Ask when the next LSAT is and you get the next 3 test dates, the registration deadline for each, and the day scores come out, all checked against LSAC. Ask what's on the test and you get the current format. Logic Games came off the LSAT in August 2024, and prep books written before then still teach it.

You can also ask if there's a free explanation for a specific LSAT question. If there is, you get the answer, a short version of our reasoning, and the link to the full walkthrough. If there isn't, you get the closest ones that exist. For practice, it links a free drill by question type or Reading Comprehension passage topic.

Ask about our prep and it'll tell you what each package includes and which one fits your test date and your score gap.

I'm Steve Schwartz. I've been coaching the LSAT since 2005, and LSAT Unplugged is me plus a team of coaches.

It won't guess your admission odds, register you for the test, quote our prices, sell you anything inside the chat, or show LSAT question text.

plugins.description:
Mailbox MCP connects ChatGPT to a mailbox you already own, on Microsoft 365, Gmail, or any IMAP host. There is no new address and nothing to migrate.

People often ask how to connect ChatGPT to Outlook. The distinction that matters is this: it does not drive the Outlook application on your computer. It opens the same mailbox Outlook opens, on the server. So it works whether Outlook is running or not, from any device, and it works the same way whether your mail lives on Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Gmail, or a hosting company's IMAP server.

It can triage what has arrived and say what actually needs you, search across folders, read a whole thread in order, read what is inside an attachment (an invoice total, a spreadsheet, a scanned letter), draft a reply for you to check before it goes, send, forward with the original attachments intact, flag, archive, report junk, and file messages into folders. It can look up someone you have written to before, tell you whether a message bounced and whether that bounce was permanent, and check the SPF, DKIM, DMARC and MX records for your own domain.

Your address book comes with the mailbox: Outlook contacts on Microsoft 365, or a CardDAV book on any host that offers one. It can find a person, read their card with the postal address and postcode, add and correct contacts, and import a contacts file. Mailboxes on Microsoft 365, and any host offering CalDAV, get calendar tools on the same connection: read and search the diary, create and update events, check who is free, find a meeting time, send and answer invitations, and set an out of office reply. Which tools appear is measured against your servers when you connect, so you are never offered one they could not honour.

Every connection carries a permission level you choose at approval: read only, draft and file, or send and delete. A shared mailbox can be worked by a team: claim a message so colleagues see who has it, hand one to a named person, and hold a draft for the owner
plugins.shortDescription: Read, send and file your email

plugins.name: app-6a84283581f08191b0cab72626586efd
plugins.description:
This plugin exposes a public register of measured conduct for MCP servers.

Five conditions are measured on a schedule: the server speaks MCP, it publishes an A2A agent card, it declares who pays it, identical input returns identical output, and the verdict itself can be recomputed by a third party. A condition that could not be measured is recorded as not measured. It is never counted as a pass, and that rule is not relaxed for the operator of the register.

The register does not rank servers. It does not recommend one server over another. It returns what was measured, when it was measured, and the SHA-256 of the record so that the reading can be checked by someone who does not trust the party that issued it.

An endpoint that is absent from the register has simply never been measured here. Absence is reported as absence and is not a negative verdict.

Determinism is not measured unless the owner of the checked server has recorded consent, because measuring it requires executing a tool on someone else's server.

Free, read only, no account and no key. The register is a build artefact of a scheduled script with no editorial step, and it is archived with a DOI so a citation survives the repository moving.
plugins.author: HORIZON SHIELD

Metronome

Need a steady beat? This metronome is ready to help. Pick a speed, press start, and follow the click. It is made for music practice that is easy, clear, and fun.

You can use it for almost any instrument. Play piano, guitar, drums, violin, bass, ukulele, flute, trumpet, saxophone, cello, or any other instrument. You can also use it for singing, dancing, clapping, marching, or learning rhythm. If you want to stay on the beat, this metronome can help.

Choose your tempo in BPM, which means beats per minute. Want to play slowly? Pick a low number. Want to play fast? Pick a high number. You are in control. Change the speed whenever you want until it feels just right.

If you do not know the BPM you need, use tap tempo. Tap along with the beat you hear in your head. The metronome will help find the speed for you. It is quick, simple, and useful.

Practice one step at a time. Start slow so your hands learn the notes. When you can play without mistakes, make the tempo a little faster. Keep doing this until you reach your goal. Small steps help you get better.

A steady beat is one of the best ways to improve. It helps your timing, rhythm, and confidence. It also helps you play with other people because everyone follows the same beat.

This metronome works well for beginners, students, teachers, hobby players, and professional musicians. It is useful during lessons, rehearsals, warm-ups, concerts, and daily practice. Whether you play for five minutes or five hours, a steady beat makes practice more helpful.

Use it to learn new songs. Use it to fix hard parts. Use it to build speed without rushing. Use it to make tricky rhythms easier to understand. You can even use it to keep a steady pace while reading music or practicing scales, chords, arpeggios, and exercises.

Ask it to build, and its answers land on the board as native Miro objects – slides, tables, docs, diagrams, sticky notes, frames, and workshop widgets – visual, instantly editable, and collaborative by default.

Key Use Cases:
Product strategy review: ChatGPT generates a strategy presentation as Miro slides, alongside your team's priorities, so the team sees the full picture and comes together to review and collaborate on it. From there, ChatGPT reads the feedback and discussion – the call transcript plus Miro comments and stickies – and writes the update for the wider team.
System design review: Get ChatGPT to create an interactive architecture diagram and documentation for a team of engineers to review and discuss ahead of upcoming changes.
Documentation automation: Set up a scheduled task in ChatGPT to keep your Miro diagrams and documents up to date as things change.
Journey mapping: ChatGPT maps out an existing user journey in Miro for the team to review in a collaborative session. From there, any proposed changes can be picked up by ChatGPT and drafted into follow-up items.

Invoke Miro directly with @Miro, or just describe what you want in plain language. Try prompts like:
- @Miro, summarize the decisions on this board [board URL]
- @Miro, turn this strategy doc into slides alongside our priorities
- @Miro, diagram this service's architecture with the docs beside it
- @Miro, update the journey map on this board with the changes we agreed
- @Miro, turn the comments on this board into action items
- @Miro, build a retro board for my team with dot voting

What Miro can do in ChatGPT:
- Read, search, and summarize context from your Miro boards

Net worth tracker: all your assets in one place. Ask ChatGPT what you're worth and how it's changed, or tell it what to update.

Moflow is a net worth tracker: all your assets in one place. What you own and what you owe, across 38 currencies, add up to one net worth. Each month, a snapshot records your balances and builds your history.

Moflow also connects your brokerage accounts and prices your holdings where supported, updates them once a day, and records your net worth every day, even when the app is closed.

Connect Moflow to ChatGPT and ask in plain words: “What's my net worth right now?” or “How has my net worth changed over the last six months?” ChatGPT can read your net worth and what it's made of; your accounts and balances, in their own currency and in yours; your holdings with their prices, cost and lots; and your transfers, goals, target mix, income, monthly burn, snapshots and trends.

Tell ChatGPT what changed and it updates Moflow for you: it sets a balance, adds or edits an account, records a holding you bought or sold, or a transfer between your accounts, sets your goals, target mix, income and burn, and closes the month with a snapshot. If a change breaks a rule, nothing is saved.

Moflow only reads from your brokerage accounts. It never trades, never places orders and never moves money at a bank or broker; its tools change your data in Moflow only. Moflow gives no investment advice.

Moflow's copy of your data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and used to serve you. The tools work on a Moflow+ account.

plugins.name: app-6a741648ade4819196fed96231554d55
plugins.description:
Muffed answers NFL questions with figures that have already been checked. Every number comes from a gated panel built on nflverse play-by-play, NFL Next Gen Stats and FTN charting data, and every response carries its own source, the date it was verified, and the attribution the data licence requires.

Ask what the data says is actually real in the NFL right now, look up a player's or team's season figures, pull a leaderboard, get a plain explanation of an advanced metric like EPA or CPOE, compare two players side by side, or check a statistic you saw somewhere else — Muffed will tell you the real value when it disagrees. You can also connect a Sleeper league by id to get verified context on the players in it.

Muffed publishes no projections, no start/sit or lineup advice, no draft grades, no rankings-as-advice and no picks, and carries no betting lines or odds. No tool on this server can produce one: there is no projection model behind it and no ranking-as-advice surface.

Every response marks its own boundary. A citation names exactly which figures it covers and states that it does not extend to analysis derived from them. Figures computed on request rather than drawn from the pre-verified panel are labelled `computed_not_verified` and carry the executed method and population size. Where Muffed holds nothing for a request, it says so explicitly, states the coverage it does have, and declines attribution for whatever fills the gap. An assistant calling this server may add commentary, comparison or recommendation of its own on top of the returned figures; that commentary is the assistant's and is outside what Muffed verifies or attributes.

Free, read-only, no account required. Fantasy scoring figures use half-PPR, the most common single redraft default, and say so wherever they appear.
plugins.author: CAMERON MAGNUSSON FAGAN

plugins.description:
Paste a LinkedIn post and see which rhetorical formulas readers have seen too often.

The plugin counts a small set of formulas and compares each count with a reference corpus of published LinkedIn posts in the same language. For every formula, it reports the value found, how the post compares with the reference posts and, when a formula is used more than usual, a concrete suggestion to say the same thing more directly.

French and English, and it says which one it measured. French carries three formulas: the "ce n'est pas X, c'est Y" contrast, three lines in a row opening on the same word, and the announced lesson ("Résultat :"). English carries one, the "it's not X, it's Y" contrast: the other two were measured on English posts and were not reliable, so they are left out.

It is a style check only. It does not rewrite the post, and it does not assess who wrote it or how it was produced. No account needed.

plugins.description:
NoPressure is a communication-skills practice for the workplace. It turns a hard conversation into a live voice roleplay you can rehearse before the real one: delivering critical feedback, saying no to a request, handling a performance review, pushing back on a stakeholder, negotiating a raise, running a first 1:1 with a new team.

Describe the situation once — who the other person is, where they stand, and what makes it hard. ChatGPT can assemble that brief from what is already in the conversation, including anything you have brought in from the other tools you use, so the character is built on the real people and the real stakes instead of a generic template. NoPressure sees only the brief it is handed: it has no access to your calendar, mail, or documents. From that brief, it generates the character, a scene image, and a voice, then shows a start card in the chat. Pressing Start opens the voice call in the NoPressure web app, where you speak out loud with someone who holds their own position and pushes back.

When the session ends, the debrief comes back to the card: the key insight, how you handled the core challenge, and where to focus next. Send it into the chat, with the transcript of what was said, and work through it with ChatGPT. Simulations are reusable, so you can run one again and compare the attempt against an earlier try, or edit its title, card description, and character first. Each one lives in your own private NoPressure workspace.
plugins.author: JetBrains s.r.o.

Omphalis is the place where what you read, hear, and note begins to cohere. You save an article, and Omphalis shows its structure. You listen to a podcast on your commute, and Omphalis helps you come back to what mattered. You watch a two-hour talk, and Omphalis shows you the shape of it in seconds. You record a voice note at midnight, and Omphalis places it beside the article, talk, or paper that belongs with it.

The paper you read last spring meets the book you are reading now, and your voice note from a walk last month sits beside both. What changed in the field, what changed in your understanding, what still holds: all part of the same library, still in reach, still connected. Not a pile that grows heavier. A place that gets clearer.

It is for people who need what they consume to stay usable later — in writing, teaching, decision-making, research, or reflection — where understanding can compound over time.

na conversa, avaliados por retorno, volatilidade, Sharpe, Sortino, drawdown
máximo, tempo de recuperação e correlação, contra benchmarks como CDI, IBOV,

móveis de 10 anos e heatmap de CAGR real por ano inicial.

Motores de simulação: fronteira eficiente e carteira de máximo Sharpe;
probabilidade de atingir uma meta de patrimônio (goal-based investing); projeção
prospectiva de patrimônio por Monte Carlo; e plano de retirada da aposentadoria
com taxa segura (SWR), taxa perpétua (PWR) e estratégias clássico,
rebalanceado, bucket e dynamic spending com guardrails.

Onsa finds real B2B prospects — actual people with LinkedIn profiles — scored against your ideal-customer profile, and keeps every search as a campaign you can come back to.

Ask for leads in plain language and Onsa's agent runs a live search, returning each person with their title, company, a 1–5 score and the written reasoning behind that score. Every search becomes a campaign, so you can grow it, steer it toward a different segment, or compare it against earlier ones to see which profile actually produced replies.

Onsa carries the outreach side too. It returns what prospects wrote back — the actual text, not just counts — alongside the funnel: invites sent, invites accepted, messages sent, and replies split by sentiment. When a draft reads like a mail-merge, you can pull up the research memo Onsa already wrote about that person and rewrite the message around one specific, checkable fact.

Sending is deliberately hard to do by accident. Queueing a LinkedIn message reaches a real human, so the tool refuses unless the exact draft text and the recipient's name are quoted back to it, it puts a confirmation in front of the person at the keyboard, and each approval is single-use and bound to one recipient and one draft. A client that cannot show a confirmation dialog sends nothing — Onsa returns a link to approve inside the app instead.

Requires an Onsa account. New workspaces start on a free trial with a prospect allowance; when the allowance runs out, every campaign, lead and reply already in the workspace stays readable.

plugins.description:
Exercise now or wait. Sell at vest or hold. Which lots to sell first. Each of these has a right answer for your specific situation, and it turns on how alternative minimum tax (AMT), holding periods, state tax, and the time value of taxes paid early interact across several years. That is where rules of thumb break down. Ask in plain language and OptionsAhoy returns the answer with the year-by-year schedule behind it.

1. Which incentive stock options (ISOs) to exercise in which year, to hold down AMT and recover the credit later. We optimize across multiple years, with your tax status in mind.

2. Whether to sell restricted stock units (RSUs) at vest or hold for long-term capital gains, and what the twelve-month cliff is actually worth. We show you the optimal solution.

3. Which vested RSU lots to sell and in what order, and what that saves against selling oldest-first (the default order your broker's UI will offer). This sounds like a minute optimization. On a $725,000 sale from a concentrated position, the gap between the optimal order and your broker's default could be over $100,000 in tax.

4. Whether non-qualified stock options (NSOs) are better exercised and sold, or exercised and held.

5. Whether your shares pass the six statutory tests for qualified small business stock (QSBS). Best to check early for potential tax savings, the rules just changed.

6. How exposed a single position leaves you, and what selling down, holding, or hedging each cost. We calculate and compare different strategies across three years, with your taxes in mind.

7. What a protective put or a zero-cost collar prices at. If you need to protect your holdings, you're probably considering a hedge. But which one? We make it easy to decide.

8. How to convert some of your holdings to a target amount of after-tax cash by a deadline with the smallest tax bill. We optimize against your inputs and risk tolerance, then you choose, the way an investment firm would.

Every result is computed agai

plugins.description:
Orkasa is the CRM that real-estate agencies in Latin America run on: client files, property portfolio, viewings, offers and documents in one place.

This connector lets the broker ask about their own work, in their own words. «How is Mrs Herrera's file going?» returns the whole dossier — her operations and the stage each one is at, the property, the viewings, the offers, the documents and the latest messages — plus the next step Orkasa's Copilot recommends, and why. «What do I have today?» returns those steps in order: what is waiting on the agent first, and among those the most overdue. It also searches the portfolio by area, type, price and bedrooms, and reads the viewing schedule.

Four tools write: create a client, book a viewing, move an operation to the next stage, and record an offer. They respect the same locks as the app: an operation does not advance while its stage is still missing documents, and in that case the connector returns the list of what is missing instead of forcing the step. Publishing listings, generating mandates and sending documents for signature do not go through the connector.

The broker authorises specific permissions («see your leads», «book viewings»), sees which domain their data will be sent to before accepting, and can cut the access off from Settings › Connections. The assistant only sees what that user sees inside Orkasa: if they cannot see the rest of the office's clients in the app, they cannot see them here either.

Requires an Orkasa account attached to an agency.

plugins.description: OsmO makes phone calls for you and answers the calls that come to you. Find a business or a company's customer care number first, call up to five numbers at once, or book a call for later in your own time zone and cancel it if plans change. From ChatGPT you can see who called and what they wanted, open a call with its transcript and a time-limited link to play the recording, check your account and today's calls, get your carrier's call-forwarding codes, and change your call settings, screening rules and assistant, including the language it speaks (English, Hindi or Spanish, where that assistant speaks it). Every call and every change is shown to you first and happens only after you say yes; one yes covers every keep-going try. What it covers: the PadelTrue catalogue, not the whole market. The ratings for power, control, handling, forgiveness and comfort are calculated from five published specifications with a formula printed on the website. They are not play tests, laboratory measurements, customer reviews or a personal fitting. When a rating input is missing the app says so, because a rating built on fewer inputs is less certain. When a maker's own page contradicts itself, the app reports the contradiction instead of choosing one side.

What it does not do: it does not sell rackets, take payments, hold accounts or give medical advice. A price is the price seen on the source page on the date shown. It does not tell you whether a racket is in stock or delivered to your country.

The app is read only and needs no sign-in. The app operates on the tool arguments sent for your request and does not request access to your full conversation or an account profile. Service request metadata and retention are described in our privacy policy.

PartnerProf is a unique tool that provides a deterministic answer to a fundamental question: does at least one feasible state exist within a locally defined reality governed by highly complex dependencies and constraints in a high-dimensional space?

Before committing resources to complex computation or a quantum problem, PartnerProf can determine whether a desired state, result, transition, or next step is feasible at all under the currently defined conditions.

Both the input and the resulting output can be certified, while the admitted state remains deterministic, reproducible, and fully auditable.

PartnerProf enables the evaluation of quantum and high-dimensional state-space problems that would otherwise be computationally impractical, including classes of simulations that may remain intractable even for current quantum hardware.

When facing a major and costly decision—or planning an experiment, test system, detector, prototype, or complex technical configuration—PartnerProf allows you to verify first whether the intended state is actually feasible within the defined reality before investing in its realization.

Pendar gives you the shape of a research field, not a summary of it.

Point it at a topic and it reports how many papers exist, whether output is growing or flattening, which disciplines and countries produce them, and which papers to read first. Every figure is counted across the whole corpus rather than estimated from a sample, so you can plan around it.

Point it at a paper and it traces what happened next: whether citations are rising or fading, which fields picked the work up, whether industry or academia is building on it, and which authors cite it most. That is how you tell a paper quietly becoming foundational from one that peaked years ago.

Paste a bibliography and it checks each reference against the published record: whether the paper exists, whether the citation describes it accurately, and whether it has been retracted. A reference it cannot find is reported as unverified rather than swapped for the nearest real paper, which matters when the citations came from a model.

Every tool is read-only. Pendar looks things up and reports what it finds.

PharmacyOS is the retail-management system a Bangladeshi pharmacy runs its counter on — point of sale, inventory by batch and expiry, prescriptions, suppliers, and NBR-compliant receipts. This connector gives the owner and staff of one pharmacy a plain-language way into their own live records.

Ask what sold last month and get the real figure, with the count, discounts, VAT and total. Ask what is running out and get the items at or below their reorder level, with a suggested quantity to cover the next fortnight. Ask who owes money and get the khata book, biggest debt first, with each customer's remaining credit. Ask what money is stuck on the shelf and get the stock that has not sold in ninety days, valued at cost. Ask about one receipt by the number printed on it and get every line, the cashier, the discount, the VAT and the customer. Ask what you actually made and get gross profit and the month's operating expenses side by side.

With the owner's opt-in it also writes: create a medicine, change a price or a reorder level, receive a batch with its expiry, log rent or a salary, add a supplier, raise a draft purchase order, record a customer's payment against what they already owe, and save a photographed supplier invoice as a review session the owner finishes in the app.

Everything is scoped to the single pharmacy the signed-in user belongs to. There is no parameter on any tool that could reach another business's data, and no way to ask for one.

It is a business tool, not a clinical one. There is no drug monograph, indication, dose, interaction or therapeutic-equivalence information in any response, and no tool that provides any. Clinical questions belong with the pharmacist.

Amounts are in Bangladeshi Taka, held as integer paisa. Dates are Asia/Dhaka. Bangla and English both work.

plugins.description:
Pile Capacity estimates the axial bearing and uplift capacity of cast-in-situ bored piles and CFA piles from a soil profile and a pile schedule, and solves the inverse problem: the length each pile needs to carry a stated compression and tension load.

Describe the ground and the piles in plain language, such as layer thicknesses and types, undrained shear strength or friction angle, rock UCS, groundwater level, pile diameters, target loads and factors of safety. The connector resolves that into a complete analysis input and shows you the resolved input, every assumption it had to make for a value you did not give, and the provenance of each field (your value, an engineering convention, or a default), so you confirm or correct the design before anything is calculated.

Confirmed designs return one summary per pile: required length, toe level, allowable and ultimate compression and uplift capacity, and the factors used. You can then render the full calculation report as a PDF with charts, formulas and per-layer tables, or as an Excel workbook with live formulas, and save the design into a project in your Pile Capacity account, where it opens in the web app like any other design.

SI and US customary units are both supported. The connector picks the system from the units you write and warns you when your words and your numbers disagree.

Requires a hetGE account with an active Pile Capacity licence. Sign-in is OAuth against id.hetge.com; the connector never sees your password and reads only the design inputs your assistant sends, plus at most one sentence of your wording when it contains unit words, used only to check the units.

plugins.description:
PlatoForms is an online form builder for web forms, fillable PDF forms and PDF documents. This plugin connects your PlatoForms account so you can work with your own forms and their submissions in conversation, instead of opening the dashboard.

What you can do

• Find forms. List published, draft or archived forms with their folder, publish state and submission count, or search by name.

• Understand a form. Read a form's full field schema — every field's id, type, label, whether it is required, its options and its validation rules — so you can reason about the data before you touch it.

• Review submissions. List a form's submissions newest-first, filter them by date range or keyword, find one by an exact field value (for example the submission where the email field is a particular address), and read every answer of a single submission with its field labels.

• Export. Mint a time-limited download URL for a submission's PDF, CSV, signing certificate, zipped attachments or a single attachment. Files are never streamed through the conversation — you get a link that expires.

• Share a prefilled link. Create one or more tracked invitation links to a form with fields already filled in, optionally single-use, optionally with an expiry. The plugin returns the URLs for you to send; it never sends email itself.

• Submit an entry. Post an entry to a published form after reading its schema, with validation errors returned verbatim so mistakes can be corrected and resubmitted.

• Start something new. Describe a form or a PDF document in plain English and get a builder link back. The design happens in the PlatoForms builder when you open the link, with its own AI asking you the clarifying questions.

How it connects

Sign in with your PlatoForms account over OAuth — your password is never shared with the assistant, access is scoped to read or read-and-write, and you can revoke it at any time from your PlatoForms account. The plugin can only see what your own account can see.

Play Texas Hold’em poker with an AI opponent, then talk about every hand with ChatGPT. This is more than a poker game. It is a place to play, learn, ask questions, and get better one hand at a time. If you are new to poker, the AI can help you understand what is happening. If you already know the game, you can test ideas, try new plans, and review your choices. Every game becomes a chance to learn.

You can sit down and start playing in just a few moments. The game follows the rules of Texas Hold’em. Cards are dealt, bets are made, and each hand plays out like a real game. When the hand ends, you can ask ChatGPT why something happened. Ask why a bet was good, why a fold was smart, or why a bluff worked. You can keep asking until it makes sense.

Learning poker does not have to feel hard. Big ideas are explained with small, simple words. If you do not know what a flop, turn, river, or blind is, just ask. If you want to know what pot odds mean, ask. If you want help reading the board or choosing between calling, raising, or folding, ask. The AI explains each step in a clear and friendly way.

You are free to play the way you want. Try safe play. Try bold play. Bluff more. Bluff less. See what happens. If something goes well, ask why. If something goes wrong, ask what you could do next time. Every choice is a chance to learn something new.

This is not only for beginners. Players with more experience can explore strategy, compare ideas, and think through tough spots. Talk about hand ranges, position, value betting, drawing hands, and bluff catching. Ask what other lines were possible. Ask what a different player might do. The conversation can go as deep as you want.

There is no rush. Take your time before every move. Think about your cards. Look at the board. Consider what your opponent may have. Then decide. After the hand, talk about the result. Learning happens before, during, and after every game.

Designers and product teams use it to try out a flow in their own design system in seconds. Anyone can use it to get a clear, usable screen instead of a long answer.

Every tool is read-only. The connector needs no account, sees only the screens ChatGPT sends it, stores nothing, and does not reach the internet. Polyxd is open source (Apache-2.0); the specification is CC-BY-4.0.

PostFast is a social media management tool. This plugin connects your existing PostFast workspace so you can run your posting workflow in conversation instead of opening the dashboard.

Plan and schedule
Draft a post, choose which of your connected accounts it goes to, attach an image or video, and place it on the calendar for a specific time. Save it as a draft, route it for approval, or approve one that is already waiting. Review what is queued and remove a scheduled post. Add an account
Generate a link that opens PostFast's account connection flow when you want to add a new social profile.

How it works
PostFast connects to each social network under its own app registrations and platform credentials, and stores your drafts, scheduled posts, media and comment history in your own PostFast workspace. This plugin is a first-party interface to that product, not a generic pass-through layer. Some tools do call a platform live, for example when publishing a post, and each of those is labelled as such.

You sign in with your existing PostFast account over OAuth. Viewing accounts, writing posts, and reading analytics are separate permissions that you grant individually, and you can disconnect at any time. The connector also exposes comment management tools used by other clients, which are not part of the workflows described here.

plugins.name: app-6a7ae2565a148191802be85a9bf06ab2
plugins.description:
Postify is a social media scheduling tool for teams: one calendar for the accounts you publish to, with drafts, scheduling, and delivery analytics in one place. The Postify plugin lets ChatGPT work that calendar with you: list posts and open a specific one, see which channels are connected, draft a new post, move a scheduled post to a different time, search your media library for an image you already uploaded, ask for a suggested posting time, publish a post immediately, or delete one. It can also pull performance figures for posts already delivered, and search Postify's own documentation when you need to know how something works.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, and issued tokens are bound to the Postify MCP endpoint. You choose scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never registered for the session, so the assistant cannot see it. Connected apps are listed in Settings and can be revoked there, and every tool call is written to an audit log you can read in the app.

The two irreversible actions — publishing and deleting — are deliberately gated twice. First, an organization setting controls whether an AI assistant may perform them at all, and that setting can only be turned on by a person inside Postify; no AI credential carries the scope needed to enable it. Second, with the setting on, the first call returns a confirmation request with a short-lived token bound to the exact arguments, which must be echoed back on a second call before anything is published or deleted. Expect that first response — it is the safety step working, not an error.

plugins.description:
Australian government open data republished as CSV, Excel, JSON, Parquet, SQLite, Arrow, GeoJSON and GeoPackage at URLs that never change. Every release is a dated, immutable version with schema, provenance and a diff. Run by National Digital. No government agency has endorsed it.

Tools:
- Search datasets: Find the slug of a served dataset.
- Read a dataset: Read a served dataset's data package and full version history.
- List a dataset's fields: List a served dataset's fields, with their types, descriptions, ranges and values, before querying it.
- List partition files: List the download files that split a served dataset's newest version by one field, such as one file per year.
- Query rows: Read individual rows of a served dataset, filtered across the whole table.
- Count and sum rows: Count, sum, average, minimum or maximum rows of a served dataset across the whole table, grouped by up to three fields.
- Compare versions: Compare two consecutive versions of a served dataset row by row on its key fields, to see what a publisher changed between releases.
- Search government portals: Search every dataset listed on Australia's government portals, including the many publicdata.au does not serve yet.
- List the build backlog: List the datasets people have asked publicdata.au to build, most votes first.
- Vote for a dataset: Add one anonymous vote for a government dataset that publicdata.au does not serve yet, so it is built sooner.

The fields of one dataset by slug: types, the publisher's descriptions, ranges and the values each field holds. Find slugs with search_datasets or resources/list.

The MCP server records nothing about who calls it or what they ask. To keep the rate limit, it counts row tool calls per address in Cloudflare's cache for 10 seconds.

plugins.description:
Qualisend verifies email addresses and cleans lists so your messages reach real inboxes and bounces stay low. Ask it to check a single address, a batch, or a whole list — you get a clear deliverable / risky / undeliverable / unknown verdict for each, with typo suggestions and disposable- and role-address detection.

It runs the full check: syntax, domain and mail server (MX), disposable and role detection, catch-all, and a real mailbox (SMTP) check. Large lists run in the background and return a result summary you can review.

On the Pro plan it also checks whether a sending domain is set up correctly (SPF/DMARC), generates the DNS records you need (SPF, DMARC, BIMI, MTA-STS), and analyzes raw email headers to diagnose deliverability. With the Blacklist Monitoring add-on it can check whether a domain or IP is on major blacklists.

Each verification uses one Qualisend credit, and you connect your own Qualisend account.

plugins.description:
QualiTaTi is an AI-powered qualitative research platform used by academic and UX researchers. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your QualiTaTi account through a hosted MCP server, so you can run a study end to end without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Interview studies: create an AI-interview project from a topic, draft or refine the interview guide, set the language, voice or text mode and duration, and get the participant link to share. QualiTaTi's AI interviewer then runs the interviews with your participants and transcribes them. You can also import transcripts you already have.
- Progress and results: list your projects and interviews, see which interviews are complete and analysed, read each interview's conversation and quality score, and read the stored analyses (themes, codes, digests).
- Analysis: run the complete analysis or inductive coding on a finished interview (this spends QualiTaTi credits and is always confirmed with you first), then pull the results into the chat as evidence-backed summaries with verbatim quotes.
- Conversational surveys: build a survey from a brief, add questions and publish it; responses are then reviewed on qualitati.com.

Three bundled skills teach the model QualiTaTi's workflows: setting up an interview study, building a survey, and reading results. The plugin works with a free QualiTaTi account. Sign-in uses OAuth 2.1; the grant inherits your plan and quotas, and access tokens expire automatically.

Connect a project and ask what you actually want to know. What did participants say about switching costs? Where do enterprise and mid-market diverge? Which quotes support the claim going in front of the board on Thursday? Quallie searches across every transcript in the project and answers in participants' own words, with each quote attributed to the person who said it.

Segment as you go. Filter participants by attribute, apply your own tag categories, and compare how different groups talked about the same theme.

Then build the deliverable in the same conversation. Quallie drafts structured report pages with headings, pull quotes, statistics and themed sections, cuts video clips from the moments you cited, and collects them into reels for a readout. Everything lands in your Quallie workspace, where you and your team can keep editing it.

Made for researchers whose job is not only to run the study, but to make the case that comes out of it.

plugins.name: quizzes
plugins.description:
Make a quiz. Take a quiz. Test what you know. This ChatGPT quiz tool lets you play, learn, and have fun with questions made just for you. Ask for a quiz on any topic. Pick how you want to answer. Get a score when there are right and wrong answers. Send your results back to ChatGPT to talk about what you know and what you want to learn next.

You can start with a few words. Say “Quiz me on space,” “Make a quiz about dogs,” or “Give me a math test.” ChatGPT can make a custom quiz for your topic. You can ask for an easy quiz, a hard quiz, or a mix. Try a quick quiz when you have a minute, or a longer one when you want more practice.

Pick the kind of questions you like. A multiple choice quiz lets you choose from a set of answers. A true or false quiz lets you say if a fact is right or wrong. A written answer quiz lets you type what you think. You can also answer open questions that have no one right answer. One quiz can use more than one kind of question.

Want to study? Use this quiz maker to check what you know. Make a study quiz about words, numbers, plants, maps, books, or any school topic. Ask for practice questions before a test. Try a mock exam to see what you can do on your own. A knowledge test can help you spot what feels easy and what needs more work.

Want to play? Make a trivia quiz for fun. Try facts about animals, food, games, sports, films, music, or the world. Ask for a quiz game with silly questions or a big challenge. Play alone and try to beat your last score. Each new quiz can be about a new thing, so there is always more to try.

Want to hear what people think? Make a survey or a set of questions with no right or wrong answer. Ask about likes, ideas, plans, or views. A survey can help you think, pick, or share how you feel. This tool can ask both fact questions and opinion questions. It does not treat every answer like a school test.

For questions with clear right answers, the quiz can give you a score. See how many you got right. Use your quiz

plugins.description:
Web search returns abstracts, paywalls, and citations that cannot be checked. Redpine returns the relevant chunk of the document.

Redpine licenses full-text research directly from publishers and research institutions, and serves it to ChatGPT/Codex over MCP alongside a large open-access corpus. One query searches both.

Provenance by default. Every result carries its publisher, title, publication date, and a resolvable identifier such as a DOI. Licensed content and open-access content are labeled separately, so the two are never confused inside an answer.

You see the price first. Any search can be previewed for free. ChatGPT/Codex sees the title, source, and a snippet of every result, plus the exact cost to unlock them, then asks before spending anything. Unlock the three results that matter instead of the 30 that came back. The same results re-fetch free for seven days. Discovery, schema inspection, previews, and balance checks are always free.

Built for questions where being wrong is expensive. Clinical decisions, systematic review, research engineering, and any analysis that has to survive a source check.

An account can also hold data integrations beyond literature. ChatGPT/Codex reads what that account is entitled to at runtime rather than assuming a fixed tool list.

Compensation flows back to the rights holders. New accounts get free queries. Credits are bought on the Redpine dashboard, and the connector never handles payment details: it shows the price and asks before anything is charged.

Requires a Redpine account. Sign-in is OAuth on first use.

plugins.description:
Revenue Analytics by DataLabs.store connects your HubSpot data to ChatGPT. It continuously replicates your portal (custom objects, deals, contacts, companies, line items, engagements, email events) into a real relational Microsoft SQL Server database whose schema matches your portal, then lets ChatGPT query it in plain English and return answers backed by the exact SQL that produced them.

Why it exists
HubSpot is built to run your CRM at scale, and its reporting tools are genuinely good at what they were designed for. The limit is structural: standard reports are built one object at a time, so questions that need several tables joined together before the math even starts do not fit. Per-deal margin (deals joined to their line items), multi-hop paths (deal to contact to company to source), correctly weighted stats (SUM(clicks)/SUM(delivered), not an average of averages), cohorts, and window functions all need a real database underneath. That is the job this fills.

What you can ask
- "Rank owners by weighted pipeline (each deal's amount times its real stage odds) and their historical win rate."
- "Unique click-through rate by acquisition source, weighted by delivered volume, for contacts who became customers."
- "Which deals are aging past 90 days, and where does our ARR actually concentrate?"
Then keep drilling: "now split by pipeline... now only Q2... now show the trend."

What makes it different
- Real joins across any objects, expressed as one query.
- Every answer is auditable: the exact SQL ships with the number, so you can verify and reproduce it.
- You bring the model: full frontier ChatGPT reasoning runs over your own data.
- Complementary to HubSpot's own AI. Breeze works inside the CRM; this understands the data behind it.

A note on sensitive data
This app's HubSpot integration requests only standard, non-sensitive OAuth read scopes for CRM analytics. It does not request HubSpot's sensitive scope grants (for example, crm.objects.contacts.sensitive.read).
plugins.author: DataLabs.store

plugins.description:
Write the perfect replies to your online reviews.

This app helps business owners write clear, personal, and polite replies to customer reviews. Copy a review, paste it into the app, and get a response that sounds friendly and professional. Save time, keep your customers happy, and build a better online reputation without staring at a blank page.

Good review? Bad review? Short review? Long review? This app can help. It creates thoughtful replies that fit the customer’s message instead of giving the same answer every time. You stay in control and can edit every reply before you post it.

Customers notice when businesses reply. A simple thank you can make a good review even better. A calm and caring answer to a bad review can show that you listen and want to help. Taking time to reply builds trust, but writing every response can take hours. This app does the hard part for you.

The app is made for busy business owners, managers, and teams. It works well for restaurants, cafés, shops, hotels, plumbers, electricians, salons, gyms, dentists, doctors, real estate agents, law firms, cleaners, contractors, and many other businesses. If people leave reviews about your business, this app can help you answer them.

Every reply is written to sound natural. The app looks at what the customer said and writes a response that matches the situation. Happy customers get warm thanks. Customers with questions get helpful answers. Customers who had a bad experience get a calm and respectful reply that shows you care.

You can change the reply before you use it. Add your own details, adjust the tone, or make it shorter or longer. The app gives you a strong starting point so you spend less time writing and more time running your business.

Replying to reviews can help your business grow. People often read reviews before they choose where to spend their money. When they see helpful replies from the owner, they know someone is paying attention. That can build confidence and encourage more

Riveter turns web research into structured data. Give Claude a list of companies, people, or URLs and ask for new columns: product descriptions, revenue, deep analysis, company headcount, link traces, pricing, tech stack analysis, contact details, a classification, a summary, etc. Riveter runs an AI agent per row that searches, reads pages, and fills in each cell with a sourced answer.

What you can do

- Enrich rows you already have. Paste a list or point at a saved enrichment and get the new columns back. Up to 10,000 rows per run.
- Build a list from a description. "Every lawfirm in Indiana", "every YC W24 company in healthcare", "competitors of Stripe". Riveter generates the rows, and can enrich them in the same run.
- Scrape a page. Clean text or markdown from any URL, including JavaScript-rendered pages.
- Search the web. One-shot search results, or a research agent that answers a question with a structured, schema-shaped response.
- Extract records from a site. Define the fields you want and pull them from listings, directories, or catalogs as JSON.
- Monitor for changes. Run a saved enrichment daily, weekly, or monthly and get alerts or webhooks when values change.

How it works

Long runs are asynchronous. Claude starts the run, checks status, and fetches results when they are ready. Every run has an id you can come back to later, and results stay available in your Riveter account.

Use it to find leads and get customers: lead generation for B2B leads and prospects by job title, industry and place, cold emails from your own Gmail, and booked sales calls. Rocketship follows up, answers replies and books the meeting on your calendar, and keeps every reply, meeting and deal in one place. This plugin lets ChatGPT run the customer-finding part of that job inside your Rocketship account.

What ChatGPT can do today: describe who you sell to and see a preview of matching buyers by name, title and company, then add the ones you want to your workspace. Look up one specific person by first and last name, optionally at a company or in a city, and add them too. Finding someone's email is a separate step you choose.

ChatGPT never posts, comments or messages anywhere. You post each reply from your own account, or turn on Post for me in Rocketship and the Rocketship Chrome extension posts your Reddit replies from your own account, within a daily limit you set.

Put people on lists, search the people already in your workspace, and have ChatGPT write an email sequence (Email 1 plus follow-ups) that is saved as a draft for you to check. Ask who replied, what was sent, what is in your pipeline, and what needs attention today.

Start or pause a campaign: starting is always a separate, confirmed step because it sends real emails from your own connected Gmail. Emma, Rocketship's AI salesperson, then follows up, answers replies and books meetings on your Google Calendar. Built for

plugins.name: rocketship-post-finder
plugins.description:
Rocketship: Reddit Leads finds public Reddit posts where people ask for what you sell.

Tell it what your business sells, where it serves customers if it is local, and who buys it if you like. It searches public Reddit posts, says how many open threads fit (up to five) and shows the best one, with its title, community, link, how old it is and one line on why your business fits. Every link is one the search really returned, and every thread is still open to replies. For a local business, it only shows posts from people in or near the place it serves.

It leaves out threads that are locked, removed, archived or older than about three months, posts by deleted accounts, adult or NSFW communities, and sensitive threads, such as ones about children, emergencies or grief. It never shows usernames and never copies the text of a post.

It only reads. It never posts, comments, votes or sends messages, and it never signs in to Reddit or to any account. You decide whether to reply, from your own account. Each answer ends with a short tip: answer the question first, say that you run the business, and leave out links unless the community's rules allow them.

No sign-in needed, and a few searches a day. Searches for restricted goods, such as adult content, gambling, drugs, weapons, tobacco or prescription medicine, are refused.

Made by Rocketship. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Reddit, Inc.

plugins.description:
Rosey is an independent verification layer for documents, decks, or other content that has been drafted, edited, or summarized by AI — financial reports, scientific writing, technical documentation, and any other content where factual precision matters.

Rosey checks Accuracy: every claim, number, and citation in a document is verified against its source materials, with findings delivered as traceable evidence rather than a bare confidence score. It also applies optional expert personas — a CFO reviewing for financial coherence, an adversarial analyst stress-testing claims, an operating partner checking operational plausibility — to surface weaknesses before an output reaches its intended audience.

Why it matters for agentic workflows: an agent that generates important outputs for users or agents downstream cannot reliably verify its own output. Verification benefits from a separate system checking claims against ground truth, the same way external audit is separate from the finance team it reviews. Rosey is built for end-users, agents, and agentic pipelines so that errors can be caught before they propagate – either to another agent or to someone who will make decisions based on the output. 

Findings are returned with in-line judgement on each factual claim, so work can move from draft → verified → finalized quickly.

Typical triggers: a document contains numerical claims, financial figures, or factual assertions; a document was generated or substantially edited by an AI model; a document is headed to a client, regulator, or decision-maker and needs a pre-send accuracy check; an agent is creating important output that will be consumed as inputs by another agent in a workflow and requires reliability.

Not for: scenarios where there is not an underlying source-of-truth that can be provided directly to Rosey.
plugins.author: InSummary

SentinelX lets you manage your Linux, macOS, and Windows servers from ChatGPT — no SSH required. plugins.name: ship
plugins.description:
SHIP is your autonomous software team. Assign a Linear, Jira or GitHub issue to SHIP, and its autonomous coding agents plan, build, review and test the change in your own GitHub repository. A mission works toward a pull request. Your CI, an automated code review and a test of its acceptance criteria each gate it.

Hand work to SHIP from the assistant you already use. File a mission from an issue in your tracker, or from a title and a description. Follow the mission through its stages, and read its verdicts, cost and session logs. Send an instruction to the agent that runs next, or leave a note for it. Read the proof that a run produced, such as test traces and screenshots.

SHIP runs agentic development as a headless AI software factory, so no screen has to be in the loop. You operate the whole mission from your coding agent, your AI assistant, your tracker or your terminal. A Planner, a Builder, a Reviewer and a Tester each do one stage of the agentic SDLC. They follow the agentic engineering practices in your repository, such as its agent instructions and skills. Your CI and a preview deploy are gates between the roles, and work that fails a gate goes back to the Builder with the reason.

Schedule maintenance missions, such as a weekly dependency upgrade. Manage the preview environments of your pull requests and the MCP servers that your agents use.

Sign in with OAuth, or send a SHIP personal access token. A token that you bind to one project can reach only the missions of that project.

You need a SHIP account and a connected GitHub repository. Create an account at https://letsship.ai.

plugins.description:
Shorty turns long videos, audio files, documents, and web pages into readable summaries and accurate transcripts. The Shorty plugin lets ChatGPT run that library end-to-end: start a summary from a YouTube link, a web page, pasted text, or a file already uploaded to your account; transcribe a publicly accessible audio or video URL; generate subtitle tracks for a video you provide; then poll the job until it reaches a terminal state and pull the finished article or transcript back into the conversation. It can also search your existing summaries, open a specific article or transcription, list what you made recently, check how much of your monthly quota is left, and search Shorty's own documentation.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE. You choose which scopes to grant on the consent screen — separate read scopes for articles, transcriptions, jobs, usage and docs, and separate write scopes for creating summaries and transcriptions — and any tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered to the assistant at all. Consent is re-checked on every individual tool call, so revoking Shorty from Connected AI Apps in Settings stops the assistant immediately rather than at token expiry. Write tools are backed by an idempotency ledger, so a retried request will not create duplicate jobs, and no tool deletes or overwrites work you already have.

Summaries and transcriptions consume your Shorty plan's monthly quota; the assistant can check the remaining balance before starting a long job.

Shruwd is an AI search visibility tool. When a buyer asks an AI assistant for the best tool in your category, a few names come back. Shruwd shows where your brand stands in those answers, works out why they leave you out, and tells you which page to change. Then it checks whether the change worked.

It asks the questions your buyers ask and records how often the answers name you and cite your pages, which competitors show up, and which of the companies you track gets named first.

To find the cause, Shruwd reads your site's logs to see which AI crawlers visit, what they fetch and which requests fail. Visits are checked against the IP ranges or DNS names each crawler's owner publishes, so a faked user agent doesn't count. It also looks at the pages the answers cite in your place. Each finding names the cause and the change to make, usually on a specific page, and says how sure Shruwd is.

You make the change. Shruwd then asks the same questions the same way and says a fix worked only when the movement clears a statistical bar and is big enough to matter.

Rates from AI answers come with their ranges, since each answer is one sample of what a buyer might see. Crawler numbers are counts from your logs, so they're exact. Shruwd doesn't roll any of them into a single visibility score.

From ChatGPT you can:
- See how often AI answers name your brand and each of your competitors, now and over time
- Go through the latest answers one by one: whether each named you or a competitor, and which pages it cited
- See what's holding your brand back, with the recommended fix for each finding
- Mark a fix as applied, so Shruwd checks again
- Set up a brand: add prompts and competitors, or have Shruwd suggest them from your homepage
- Check which AI crawlers reach your site, once your logs are connected

It's built for founders and small marketing teams without an SEO department. To connect, sign in with your Shruwd account and choose read-only or read-and-write access. Setting up a
