Play chess without leaving ChatGPT. Start a new game in seconds, make moves in normal chess language, and talk about every part of the game as you play. You can ask why a move is good, why a move is bad, what to do next, or how to get better. This app is made for people who want to play, learn, and have fun at the same time.

The app is easy to use. Just begin a game and make your moves. You can use simple move names, standard chess notation, or ask questions in plain English. If you are not sure what to do, ask for help. The game keeps going while you chat, so learning feels natural instead of like reading a long lesson.

If you are brand new to chess, this app is a friendly place to start. It explains ideas in small, simple steps. It tells you what each piece can do and why some moves are stronger than others. You never have to pretend you understand. Just ask another question. You can learn one move at a time.

If you already know how to play, you can go deeper. Talk about openings, middle games, endgames, tactics, strategy, planning, and common mistakes. Ask why a position feels better for one side. Compare different moves. Explore new ideas. The conversation changes to fit your questions.

Play at your own speed. Think for a long time or move quickly. Stop to ask about a position. Go back and look at an earlier move. Try a different idea and see what could happen. Chess is not only about finding the best move. It is also about understanding why that move works.

The app can explain forks, pins, skewers, discovered attacks, double checks, sacrifices, passed pawns, king safety, piece activity, space, time, and many other chess ideas using clear language. Hard topics become easier because you can ask for another explanation whenever you need one.

Want to improve? Review your games after they finish. Talk about turning points, missed chances, and strong moves. Ask where the game changed. Find patterns in your play. Learn from mistakes instead of simply seeing that

- "I run a café taking $40,000 a month on card. Which payment provider is cheapest?"
- "What would payroll cost for 12 employees?"
- "We have two shops. Which POS system costs the least?"
- "Which business checking account has the lowest fees?"

It covers payment providers and card machines, POS systems, payroll, HR, accounting, CRM, inventory, email marketing, e-commerce platforms, website builders and more, plus business checking, savings accounts and credit cards in the US.

It works anywhere. You get local prices for the United States (SMBCompare.com), the United Kingdom (SMECompare.co.uk) and Australia (MerchantCompare.com.au), and US prices in US dollars everywhere else, clearly labelled.

Prices come from each provider's published rates. You'll see which figures were assumed, what a price leaves out (like card processing fees) and when a provider's plans don't fit your size. Each answer links to the full comparison on our site, where you can ask up to four providers for a quote. Where we have a current provider offer on record, the answer gives its one-line headline and a link to the details, and it can list the providers in a category that have one.

Ranking is by estimated cost only. Commission and offers never change the order. SMB Compare is independent and may earn a commission when you choose a provider through our sites. It's read only: it never submits forms or sends messages, and it only sees the business figures you give it, never your name, email or phone number.

Socra Cortex helps people and teams stop repeating the same preferences, requirements, and decisions to ChatGPT and Codex. It keeps that knowledge and its reasons in a single source of truth that agents can retrieve before acting, across conversations and tools.

Team members can own different subjects while their knowledge works together. For example, a product requirement Module created in ChatGPT can depend on architecture and security Modules maintained by their owners. Codex can Flash that requirement before implementing it and receive those decisions together.

As conversations and work reveal new knowledge, agents propose changes to existing Modules, so the knowledge always stays up to date. The suggested workflow asks them to show exact Before and After content and Dependencies for the owner's approval before saving. Updates become available on later Flashes, while version history preserves earlier knowledge and records changes.

Issues connect tasks to the Modules governing them, with assignees, work dependencies, comments, and evidence. Inboxes show unblocked work to its responsible person or agent; completed Issues preserve the outcome and history.

People and teams own the knowledge in their Socra Account, with Module permissions for people and groups. Review Modules, the knowledge map, and work at https://cortex.socra.com. Connect ChatGPT, Codex, or any other AI provider to that same Account with Cortex access.

plugins.description:
StrategyTune is a backtesting platform for trading strategies, and this plugin gives ChatGPT hands-on access to it.

ChatGPT can write and save the pieces you build with — chart indicators, reusable market conditions (StrategyTune calls them signals and filters), and full trading strategies — then run them tick-by-tick against real historical market data in StrategyTune's sandboxed cloud. A simple strategy backtests a year of history in seconds, so you can iterate fast.

It is not limited to automated strategy backtesting. ChatGPT can run custom research code in the same sandbox: count how often a condition occurred, measure values at specific moments, gather your own statistics and write logs during the run. You say what you want to check, ChatGPT writes the code, runs it, reads the output back, and tells you what it found.

When a run finishes you get the full report — performance statistics and the individual trades behind them. ChatGPT can also work with a StrategyTune chart you already have open: read the bars and each indicator's computed values, add and configure indicators, mark those conditions on the timeline so you can see exactly when they held, and switch instrument or timeframe. Reading the computed values also lets it debug its own work: if an indicator it wrote looks wrong on your chart, it can check the actual numbers behind the line instead of guessing.

Everything runs on historical data. The plugin does not connect to a broker, place live orders, or give investment advice.
plugins.author: StrategyTune

plugins.name: app-6aa9f5eb007c819194248395d60a84b1
plugins.description:
Stratify backtests Indian index option strategies on a year of real 1-minute NIFTY options data. Describe the trade in plain words — the legs, when to enter, how to manage it while it is open — and the server runs it against every trading day in the window and returns what actually happened.

Every result carries P&L after real charges (brokerage, STT, exchange and SEBI fees, GST, stamp duty) and modelled slippage, return on margin from a SPAN calibration, and an honesty panel: an out-of-sample split, walk-forward folds, a bootstrap interval, and a deflated Sharpe that accounts for how many variants you have already tried. No ratio is reported below 30 trades. Every backtest gets a shareable report page with the equity curve, the rules card and every trade.

The open strategy protocol covers any number of legs on any expiry; strikes by delta, premium, points or percent; per-leg stops and targets; rolling a tested side; entry gates on VIX, index RSI/EMA/SMA and combined premium; clock-time entries and exits; and portfolio rules such as pausing after consecutive losses.

Data never leaves the server — a backtest returns results, not rows. No trades are executed and no financial advice is given: the service never calls a strategy good. Free tier: NIFTY, one year, 100 backtests an hour. Requires a free Stratify account (sign in via OAuth).

Connect Subtext, and your Codex agents can open real production sessions and investigate them directly—no scrubbing a timeline, no video to watch.

Then it files the fix or hands you the finding. You review the answer, not the replay.

What your agent gets:
* **Session tools it calls directly**: open a session, jump to a moment, inspect and compare state—purpose-built so agents traverse dense session data efficiently, with fewer tokens than pointing a general agent at raw replay.
* **Best-in-class capture from Fullstory**: Fullcapture behavior, pixel-perfect screenshots on demand, DOM diffs, and windowed console and network context.
* **Privacy built for production**: precision tools for agents to mask or exclude sensitive fields, plus agent-friendly DLP scanning tools over MCP.
* **Cost-effective**: Capture every session without sampling and never miss a critical user experience or bug report. Agents review the ones that matter most.

Works with Codex or any MCP-compatible agent. Code-first install, self-serve signup, generous free tier, usage-based pricing. Bring your own agent harness—Subtext is the session context it was missing.

plugins.description:
SuperBooks is bookkeeping for freelancers and small teams: bank transactions with AI categorisation, invoices, customers, a receipt inbox and document vault, a time tracker, and financial reports. The SuperBooks plugin lets ChatGPT work your books from your own account: list and inspect transactions, fix a category or workflow status, find unpaid or overdue invoices, draft a new invoice for a customer (drafts are never sent until you say so), look up customers and add new ones, search receipts and documents, match a receipt to a transaction, start and stop time tracking, and pull profit & loss, burn rate, runway, spending by category, revenue, balances, top customers and recurring expenses.

Access runs through OAuth 2.1 with PKCE and dynamic client registration; you approve read and write scopes on the consent screen, and a tool whose scope you did not grant is never offered. Destructive operations — deleting transactions, customers, categories, tags, documents or inbox items, and voiding invoices — are hidden behind a team-level "Destructive AI tools" switch that is OFF by default, on top of the credential's own scope. Every credential is rate-limited (120 calls a minute) and can be revoked at any time from Settings → Developer.

The plugin never moves money: bank connections, payments and billing are only reachable in the app. Sending an invoice e-mails it to your customer, and nothing else leaves your account. No purchases are made in-tool, no images, video or audio are generated, and no ads are served.

What ChatGPT can do:

- Revise existing scripts in place. Updates touch only the fields you ask for, so the rest of your setup stays as you left it
- Read your library: list scripts newest first, pull the full text of any script, and see what's inside each folder
- Organize: create folders, rename them, and move scripts between folders or back to the root

You'll need a Teleprompter.com account; the integration is available on every account tier. Connecting uses OAuth, so there are no keys to copy or store, and you choose which permissions to grant: reading and writing scripts and folders are separate approvals, so read-only access is a valid choice. ChatGPT only ever sees your own personal workspace.

Scripts saved here are the same scripts your Teleprompter apps read, so anything drafted in a conversation is waiting for you the next time you open one up.

You stay in control. Deleting things, changing many items at once, emailing customers, recording refunds and changing store settings first show a preview; nothing changes until you confirm. Every change is kept in a 30-day history that you can list, and most changes can be undone; permanent deletions cannot. TendMyStore never moves money: refunds are recorded in WooCommerce, and payment refunds stay with you and your payment provider. Payment credentials are never read or changed.

Sign in with your store. Enter your store's address, sign in to WordPress if asked, and approve TendMyStore on your store's own approval screen. TendMyStore never receives your WordPress login password: the approval creates a separate application password for TendMyStore, which it keeps encrypted and which you can remove at any time under Users > Profile > Application Passwords. That application password has the same access as the WordPress account you approve with; for an administrator, that is the whole site, so approve as a Shop Manager for less access. If your store cannot use this approval, TendMyStore offers a WooCommerce key approval instead.

Instead of thousands of random listings, the app focuses on selected properties from a regionally specialized real estate agency.

Easier comparison of different locations
Users can directly recognize how residential areas differ — for example, between urban Munich and quieter surrounding towns.

Less time wasted on unsuitable listings
Many users choose based on location first. The visual search makes this step much faster.

Direct contact with a local expert
Interested users can easily send inquiries or arrange viewings without having to switch between multiple platforms.

More enjoyable mobile experience
The search feels more intuitive because users can browse the map and actively explore different regions.

- Is this TikTok sound or song blowing up or already over? (Sound Momentum, by sound link or by title and artist)

plugins.description:
trainedby.ai connects your wearables to ChatGPT, so your AI coach knows your real training load, sleep patterns, and recovery without you typing a word.

**The problem with AI fitness coaching today**

People are turning to ChatGPT to plan their marathon training, strength programs, or HYROX prep. It makes sense, because AI is available 24/7, extremely patient, and quite knowledgeable.

But somehow it doesn't quite work.

And that is because you have to tell it everything. Every. Single. Time.

Every conversation starts from zero. You have to describe in detail your current level, recent workouts, schedule, and goals. You paste in screenshots from Garmin. You try to remember what you did last week, how you slept, that your resting HR has been elevated, or that your HRV has been trending down for weeks.

The advice is based on what you told it, not what actually happened.

And what you tell it is incomplete, subjective, and often wrong.

What if your AI coach could see everything?

We connect your wearables (Garmin, Oura, Whoop, Apple Health, and 50+ other platforms) directly to your AI assistant.

When you open ChatGPT and ask about your training, it already knows:
- Workouts from the past weeks, months, and year
- Sleep quality and patterns
- Heart rate variability and resting heart rate trends
- Daily activity and recovery metrics
- Nutrition and menstrual cycle data (if you track it)

No more context dumps. No more subjective self-reporting.

**How it works**

We use smart compression to turn weeks of wearable data into something an AI can understand and analyze. Instead of dumping raw heart rate readings into a chat window, we surface the trends and patterns that matter—elevated resting HR, declining HRV, increasing training load, poor sleep consistency.

The data rolls up from days to weeks to months to years, so you can spot trends.

And because it's integrated into ChatGPT, you just start chatting.

Beyond wearable data, you can add notes like workout goals,
plugins.author: Joost Rothweiler

Traveler.md gives AI assistants and agents a memory for how you actually travel.

All of your travel preferences, saved in one place: how you like to fly, where you like to stay, what you eat, how you pace a trip, who you travel with. All of your trips, saved in one place too, in portable Trip.md files that update as your plans evolve. Each trip now comes with an itinerary, a day-by-day view of your flights, stays, reservations, and plans, so you can see the whole trip at a glance. Instead of re-explaining yourself in every conversation, your assistant loads your travel memory and plans with your preferences already in mind.

What AI assistants and agents can do with Traveler.md:
- Read your preferences so recommendations reflect how you really travel, from the first message
- Update your travel memory when they learn something new about you
- List, read, create, and update your trips, so bookings and plans stay organized as they change
- Add itinerary events like flights, hotel stays, dinner reservations, and activities, building a clear day-by-day plan for every trip

You stay in control. Your Traveler.md belongs to you, not to any single platform. Access uses OAuth with granular scopes, so you approve exactly what can be read or changed, and you can disconnect at any time. Your travel memory stays yours.

Great for:
- Planning trips without repeating your preferences every time
- Seeing your whole trip laid out day by day in one itinerary
- Keeping a running record of trips in progress
- Recommendations that account for your loyalty programs, seat preferences, and travel style
Carrying one travel profile across every tool you plan with

To get started, connect Traveler.md, sign in or create a free account, and authorize access. Your preferences, trips, and itineraries load automatically whenever travel comes up.

Travelsearch is a structured travel search and discovery tool that returns highly relevant holiday options based on natural language queries.

It enables AI agents to match user intent (e.g. destination, budget, dates, amenities, travel style) to real, bookable travel inventory using enriched, multi-source product data.

Users can describe their trip in plain language, such as:

“Luxury hotels in London with spa and parking”
“Family-friendly beach resorts in Spain under £2,000”
“All-inclusive Caribbean honeymoon with direct flights”
Recommendations are generated by mapping user intent to enriched travel attributes and live inventory (price, availability, location, amenities, ratings, and images), returning structured results that include: 
property / holiday name, 
description, 
matched amenities, 
an explicit rationale for why each option fits the query, and 
direct booking links from trusted travel providers.
Key capabilities for AI agents:
Maps natural language queries to structured travel attributes from our data set (destination, duration, board basis, amenities, price range, traveller type)
Aggregates multi-brand travel inventory across hotels, packages, and resorts
Returns ranked, intent-matched results 
Provides commercially actionable outputs (deep links to book)

Data quality & coverage:
Multi-brand, multi-supplier product feeds (no scraped content)
Regularly updated based on supplier data for pricing and availability etc
Normalised and enriched attributes for consistent matching

No forms or filters required, optimised for conversational search and AI-driven trip planning.

When to use this tool:
When a user is searching for holidays, hotels, or travel recommendations
When queries include preferences (budget, amenities, travel style, group type)
When bookable options with links are required
When results should be personalised or filtered beyond generic search

plugins.description:
Triad Astro reads your birth chart in three astrological traditions at once - Western (Tropical), Vedic (Sidereal), and Chinese (BaZi / Four Pillars) - and shows you where they agree.

Give it a birth date, plus a time and place if you know them, and it calculates all three charts in a single step: Sun, Moon and rising signs, planetary aspects and elemental balance from the Western system; Nakshatra, Navamsa, planetary dignity and the Vimshottari Dasha timeline from the Vedic system; and the Four Pillars, Day Master and ten-year Luck Pillars from the Chinese system.

Most astrology tools give you one system's answer. Triad Astro gives you three, then helps you read the overlap - the themes that show up independently in all three are the ones worth a closer look.

plugins.name: app-6a7ae3809a148191ac2fa410c17f26c7
plugins.description:
uNotes is a study library of university course materials — past exams, assignments, lab reports and lecture notes, organized by school and course. The uNotes plugin gives ChatGPT read access to that library and to the user's own study data: it can search the library, open a document and read its full text, list the user's flashcard decks and quizzes, look up their study streak, check how much of their monthly quota is left, and list the schools and courses they follow.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin exposes eight tools, all declared readOnlyHint:true / destructiveHint:false / idempotentHint:true, and none of them create, edit or delete anything in a uNotes account. Typical use is asking a question about material the user already has — "what do my Biology notes say about cell structure", "which courses am I following", "how long is my study streak" — and letting ChatGPT pull the answer out of the underlying documents.

Access is authorized with OAuth 2.1: PKCE (S256) with dynamic client registration, an explicit consent screen, and seven granular read scopes (search, documents, flashcards, quizzes, study, profile, library) plus offline_access. Tools are registered per request against the scopes the token actually carries, so a grant that omits a scope makes the matching tools invisible rather than merely blocked. Requests are rate-limited per user, and tools never accept a user identifier as input — every call is scoped to the authenticated account's own data.

plugins.description:
Uptimely is an uptime monitoring and incident management platform. The Uptimely plugin lets ChatGPT work across your projects: read a project overview, list and open monitors along with their status history and targets, list and open incidents, list alerts, list maintenance windows, see who is currently on call, list status pages, and list telemetry services. With write access enabled it can also create a monitor, run an on-demand monitor probe, declare an incident, change incident or alert state, save a postmortem, and create an alert.

You connect by signing in to your existing Uptimely account over OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, granting a subset of thirteen granular scopes at the consent screen; project API keys work for non-interactive clients. All seven write tools stay inert until a project owner turns on Allow AI write operations, which is off by default, because some of them page real people or change what a public status page shows. Connected assistants can be reviewed and revoked at any time from Connected AI apps in your user settings.

Twenty tools over Streamable HTTP: thirteen read-only and seven write. The six tools that dispatch outside Uptimely are marked as such in their metadata. The plugin processes no payments, generates no images, video, or audio, and serves no ads.

plugins.description:
Vaquill AI is a legal research tool for United States law. Ask a legal question and ChatGPT finds the statutes and regulations that answer it, quotes their text, and cites each one with a link to the official government source. It can also check whether a citation is real, point to the exact provision it names, and compare how different states handle the same issue.

What it covers: the US Code, the Code of Federal Regulations, the statutory codes of all 50 states plus DC and Puerto Rico, state regulations, federal and state court rules and constitutions, federal agency guidance from 53 named sources, agency adjudications, the Statutes at Large and the Federal Register. That is more than 5.4 million sections, including repealed and historical provisions, each marked with its status.

What you can do: search all of it at once or narrow to one state or body of law; look up a citation such as 42 U.S.C. 1983; read a section in full, or as it stood on a past date; see which sections cite a provision, the terms it defines, and the matching rule in other states.

What it does not do: it does not hold court opinions, foreign law or live bill status, and it does not give legal advice. Status labels report what the official publisher records about repeal or replacement; where currency cannot be confirmed, the answer says unknown.

An information and calculation tool for visa applications by citizens of Türkiye (ordinary/burgundy passport).

It answers questions like "Do I need a visa for Japan?", "How much does a German visa cost?" and "How many Schengen days do I have left?" — always with its source.

What it covers:

· Visa status for 172 countries — 55 visa-free, 23 visa on arrival, 30 e-visa, 64 requiring a consulate application
· Per country: the fee, the published processing time, the application centre and the required documents
· Refusal rates for Schengen applications made from Türkiye, based on European Commission statistics (27 countries)
· Appealing a refusal: the competent authority, deadline, language and fee for seven Schengen countries, and the meaning of all 17 refusal grounds on the standard form
· Calculators: the Schengen 90/180 day allowance, multiple-entry (cascade) eligibility, and the total cost in Turkish lira at the central bank rate

How the data is collected:

Every amount and duration is verified against an official consulate, ministry or legislative source, quoted verbatim. A value that cannot be verified is not published — nothing is estimated; the field is left empty and said to be empty. Answers carry their source and last-updated date.

Only the consulate of the country concerned can grant a visa. We are not an agency: we do not file applications, book appointments, or guarantee approval.

plugins.description:
Ask about a US election — the 2026 midterms ahead, or any presidential election since 1788 — and get an answer with a date on it.

For 2026: the consensus competitiveness rating for any of the 100 Senate seats and 435 House districts, a consensus of Cook Political Report and Sabato's Crystal Ball, along with which races are genuinely in play and what forecasters have changed their minds about since the last update.

The part a chat assistant cannot do on its own is the arithmetic. Describe a scenario in plain language — "Republicans hold every toss-up but lose Maine" — and VoteMapper resolves it against the ratings in effect and returns a full chamber map you can argue with. Click any race to reassign it and the tally follows. The Senate has 65 seats that are not on the 2026 ballot and are already counted; getting that right is the difference between a real answer and a confident wrong one.

For history: every presidential election from 1788 to 2024, as a map rather than a paragraph. Compare two elections and see which states changed hands, trace one state's whole voting history and current streak, or reassign states to ask what a different outcome would have meant. Multi-way elections like 1860 and 1912 come back whole rather than flattened into two parties.

You can also check a sealed VoteMapper forecast. A prediction declared in the app is verified here by fingerprint and scored against published race calls once results land — over called races only, so an uncalled race is never counted as a miss.

VoteMapper is a simulator. It reports no live vote counts, returns or called races, and its historical data holds electoral votes, not popular-vote totals. Every answer carries the date its data was published, both parties are treated symmetrically throughout, and the connector takes no position on any race.

Read-only and stateless: no account, no sign-in, nothing written, nothing retained between requests.

plugins.description:
Website Check gives a plain-language safety summary of a website, built for veterinary clinics and other small practices.

Give ChatGPT a website address and the check reads the site's public pages and public records: the same things any browser or email server can see. Nothing is installed, no login is needed, and nothing on the site is changed.

What it checks:
- Out-of-date software: WordPress core, plugins and themes, Joomla, Drupal and PHP, compared with public data from Wordfence Intelligence, the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities list and endoflife.date.
- Secure connection: whether HTTPS works, when the certificate expires, whether visitors are sent to the secure version, and files loaded without encryption.
- Browser protections: Strict-Transport-Security, Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options and Referrer-Policy.
- Domain: how soon the domain registration expires.
- Email: whether SPF and DMARC records protect the domain against email that pretends to come from it.

Results come back grouped as Urgent, Important, Good to fix and Working, each with one plain sentence. The summary leaves out software names and version numbers. A link offers the full details: software versions, known flaws with their CVE IDs, and the evidence behind each result. They are emailed only to an address at the checked site's domain or one published on the site.

A clean result means none of these checks found a problem. It is not a full security audit.
plugins.author: PupPilot

Whisper Money is a privacy-first personal finance app: your financial data is yours, and it is never shared with third parties. This app connects ChatGPT to your own Whisper Money account so you can analyse your money in plain language instead of clicking through dashboards.

Ask questions like "how much did I spend on groceries last month", "what's my net worth trend this year", "which subscriptions are draining me" or "break down Q2 by category" — the app reads your transactions, accounts, categories, labels, cashflow and net worth and answers with your real numbers. You can also keep your books tidy from the conversation: log manual transactions, recategorize and label existing ones, record balances for manual accounts, and manage categories, labels and automation rules.

Your synced bank data is protected: transactions imported from a bank connection can be categorized and labelled, but never edited or deleted, and balances can only be recorded on manual accounts. You can still add your own manual transactions to a bank-connected account — a sync never removes them. Data is scoped to the account you sign in with, including any shared spaces you belong to. The app reads and writes bookkeeping records only — it can never move money, make payments or reach any account outside Whisper Money.

Requires a Whisper Money account on a paid (Pro) plan. Sign in happens through Whisper Money's own OAuth flow — ChatGPT never sees your password, and access can be revoked at any time from your account settings.
plugins.author: Víctor Falcón Ruíz

plugins.description:
Who What Wear brings the women's fashion publication's editorial voice into ChatGPT. It works like having a stylist who already knows your taste — once you've set up a short style profile, every fashion question gets a personalised, brand-aware answer instead of a generic one.

Setup takes about a minute. A guided four-step widget asks for your style words (Low-Key Luxury, Tailored, French, Sporty, Trend-Forward and others), the brands you actually shop across contemporary, luxury, denim and accessories, the style icons whose looks you'd happily borrow, and the price range you're comfortable with. The profile is saved per user, so it carries across conversations rather than starting over every time you open ChatGPT.

After onboarding, three things become useful.

Shopping for a specific item. Tell the app what you're looking for — "find me a black blazer under £250", "I need a coat for a winter wedding", "what jeans should I buy" — and it returns three to five picks weighted toward the brands you already buy from, plus a complete outfit built around the piece: what to wear on top, on the bottom, on your feet, and one or two accessories. The aim is to leave with a wearable answer, not a list of links.

Editorial inspiration. Ask what you should be wearing or looking at right now, and the app pulls fresh articles from Who What Wear UK's live editorial feed, then picks the two or three that match your taste using the brand and category tags on each article. The picks render as a horizontal carousel of cards in the publication's own visual language: editorial image, kicker, headline, byline credit, and a link straight back to the article on whowhatwear.com.

Refining your profile. Taste shifts. Reopen the onboarding to update any answer (and only the answers you want to change), or reset the profile entirely if you're starting fresh.

A few things worth knowing. The editorial feed is Who What Wear UK, so the content leans British in voice, currency and seasonality. Reco

The reading experience stays simple. The original text remains front and center while annotations appear only where they are useful. Students can use the app to prepare for class, review assigned readings, or understand challenging passages before discussions and exams. Teachers can use it to explore different ways of explaining the same text. Lifelong learners can finally tackle books and articles that once felt too difficult.

Yamdu is the production management platform for film, TV and commercial productions. Teams use it to break down scripts, plan shooting schedules, build call sheets, manage cast and crew, and keep budgets and time cards in one place.

The Yamdu connector gives your AI assistant read-only access to the productions you work on. Sign in with your Yamdu account and ask questions in plain language - the assistant looks up the answer in your live project data and links back to the relevant page in Yamdu.

What you can ask about
- Projects, creative works and the people and companies involved
- Script breakdown: scenes, characters, sets, wardrobe, props, effects, special actions and audio
- Shooting schedules, shooting days and production calendars
- Call sheets with call times, locations and notes
- Crew list, cast and production locations
- Budget scenarios and their totals
- Time cards, aggregated totals and labor agreements

Typical questions
- "Which scenes with Anna are still unscheduled?"
- "Summarize tomorrow's call sheet and list the crew call times."
- "How does the current budget scenario compare to the approved one?"
- "Which locations do we shoot at next week, and what are their addresses?"

Access and permissions
The connector never writes to Yamdu and only reads what you are allowed to see in the app. Your project roles and department permissions apply exactly as they do in Yamdu, and sensitive personal data such as contact details is only returned when your company allows it. A company administrator must enable the MCP Server in the company settings before members can connect. Access can be limited to selected projects and data areas and can be revoked at any time.

Requirements
- A Yamdu account
- A company plan that includes the MCP Server (AI Connections) feature
- MCP access enabled by your company administrator

Yamdu is developed and operated in Germany. All data is hosted in the EU.

plugins.description:
For people in Japan who want to sell a used motorcycle, moped or scooter.

What this app does
- Model identification: from a loose description such as "the 150cc Honda PCX" or "a 50cc scooter I used to ride", it matches the vehicle against our dataset of 842 models. Models not in the dataset are directed to a phone consultation.
- Estimated buyback price by condition: an estimate in Japanese yen across five condition grades - like-new, running/very good, running/typical for its age, running with damage or faults, and non-running or accident-damaged.
- Request a free on-site appraisal: it submits the customer's name, phone number, area and model, then returns a reference number. The appointment is NOT fixed at that moment; our staff call back to agree the date. Up to three preferred times can be included (all optional).

Service area
Seven prefectures: Kanagawa, Tokyo, Saitama, Chiba, Ibaraki, Gunma and Yamanashi. The area widens as we add partner dealers. Travel, appraisal and cancellation are all free of charge.

Who carries out the appraisal
Every request is received by UsedBikeCenter ZAMA and we handle all first contact. Inside Kanagawa we visit and buy directly. In the other six prefectures we introduce a partner secondhand-goods dealer, and that partner carries out the on-site appraisal and the purchase; we act as the introducer and receive a referral fee. In those cases the request details - name, phone number, area, model, condition, preferred times and notes - are shared with that partner and used only to arrange and carry out the appraisal. This is stated in our privacy policy.

Before anything is sent
The tool first returns a preview of the request together with the sharing notice above. It transmits only after the customer has reviewed it and given explicit consent. Until then the tool returns the preview only.

No payments inside ChatGPT
This app only looks up price estimates and submits a request for a free appraisal. There is no payment, checkout, orde

plugins.description:
Chashmalink answers questions about Israeli household electricity from measured smart-meter data rather than estimates off a bill.

Behind it sits an analysed corpus of more than 20,000 Israeli households across 500+ municipalities, each a full hourly export from Israel Electric Corporation — up to 17,520 meter readings per home. That is what lets these tools answer with a number rather than a rule of thumb.

Ten read-only tools:

• compare_electricity_plans — rank every plan on the Israeli market by what it would save a specific household, per month and per year. Takes a monthly kWh figure or, far better, a 24-hour load curve.

• simulate_solar_tracks — price Israel's two mutually exclusive rooftop solar tracks against a real load shape, with payback and a recommendation. Which one pays more depends on WHEN a household consumes — the thing a roof-area calculator cannot see.

• get_city_consumption_benchmark — median monthly consumption, profile mix and 24-hour curve for a given Israeli city.

• get_national_load_curve — national demand by hour, day of week and season.

• classify_consumption_profile — classify a home as evening, night, morning, weekend or balanced, with peakiness and a night-shift opportunity figure.

• estimate_appliance_cost, size_air_conditioner, compare_ev_running_cost — running costs for appliances, air conditioning and electric cars at the current tariff.

• get_supplier_directory — every supplier and plan with its discount structure.

• how_to_export_my_iec_data — how a household downloads its own consumption file.

Privacy: no per-household data is reachable here. Every figure is either computed from the caller's own inputs or is a population aggregate published only where at least 25 analysed households sit behind it; a thinner cohort is refused rather than answered thinly. Nothing here writes, submits or contacts anyone.

Free, no account, no API key. Figures are in shekels and kWh.
plugins.author: סיני אליחי

Give your birth date, time and city, and Astrology Doctor Fortune finds your zodiac signs and draws a full birth chart — Sun, Moon and Rising, all ten planets, twelve houses and every major aspect — on an interactive chart wheel you can explore right inside the chat.

Three readings in one app. Natal chart: what your zodiac placements say about your personality, your strengths and your blind spots. plugins.name: app-69efccfd9e888191b7ad7cd147918530
plugins.displayName: オカムラメイト (賃貸版)
plugins.description:
AIによる住まい探しは、探すサイトに何十万件の規模で掲載物件があっても意味がありません。住まいを探すユーザーには限定された希望生活圏があり、その選ぶエリアに正確で豊かな物件情報が一定数あれば、カスタマージャーニーとしての住まい探しが成立します。

本アプリは、Profile（基本属性）、Equipment（設備）、Geography（地理）、Sensation（感覚）、Dimension（寸法）、Layout（間取り）からなる PEGSDLの6軸で構造化された賃貸住宅データをもとに、AIの協調推論により物件を検索・推奨します。該当物件は、デジタルツインVRをチャット内に表示して内見体験ができ、VRがない物件では代替画像が表示されます。さらに、これらのデータをもとにAIがVR空間内で物件をガイドします。

掲載データは、千葉県・東葉高速鉄道沿線の「船橋日大前」「八千代緑が丘」「八千代中央」「東葉勝田台」「村上」の各駅と、総武線・京成松戸線「津田沼」の駅から半径1km圏内を対象エリアとして、掲載事業者が取り扱う賃貸マンション・アパートの在庫情報を1日3回更新し掲載しており、信頼性の高い情報に基づいています。AI時代の新しい賃貸住宅探しを体験してください。

＜特徴①：自然言語での物件検索＞
チェックボックスなどの従来型UIではなく、PEGSDLの6軸で構造化されたデータをもとに、ユーザーが思い描く物件の価値文脈をAIが協調推論します。不動産会社の窓口で会話するように、自然言語で物件検索が可能です。

＜特徴②：曖昧な希望条件に対応＞
賃料や間取りといった一般的な条件に加え、「緑が見える眺望」「おしゃれなお風呂」などの感覚的な条件や、「できれば広め」「できれば新しめ」といった数値化されていない曖昧な条件も加味した検索が可能です。

＜特徴③：多機能なVRコンテンツ表示＞
実寸法を反映した3DモデルによるVR表示が可能です。ウォークスルー、採寸、家具配置シミュレーション、Googleストリートビュー連携などの機能により、現地に行かなくても空間の雰囲気をリアルに体験できます。
plugins.shortDescription: AI時代、6軸推論で賃貸住宅を最適検索・VR内見

plugins.displayName: 中央社新聞 CNA TAIWAN NEWS
plugins.description:
CNA provides a trusted, source-based news search and research service that allows users to search Central News Agency reporting directly within ChatGPT, stay informed about recent developments, and organize the evolving context surrounding specific people, events, and public issues.

Using natural language, users can search CNA news reports as well as content from CNA almanac, special features, and multilingual news coverage in English, Japanese, Indonesian, and other languages. The service also supports searches for standardized translations of foreign names and proper nouns, news photographs, government information, and fact-checking materials, helping users compare information across multiple sources and clarify uncertain claims. It can also organize retrieved information into event timelines, concise topic briefs, newspaper-style layouts, and relationship maps of people and organizations. These capabilities are suitable for news research, event retrospectives, issue tracking, information verification, content planning, and background research.

Responses preserve news headlines, publication dates, source information, and links to original articles whenever possible, allowing users to review the original reporting and conduct further verification. Some search results may come from government agencies, fact-checking organizations, contributed content, or other image sources; the system identifies their origins where available. The use and licensing of images remain subject to the terms, copyright requirements, and other applicable rules of their original sources.
plugins.author: Central News Agency

plugins.name: app-6a9b5a9e8f808191831c8655ee2191ae
plugins.displayName: 日本の補助金・公的支援検索
plugins.description:
Find Japanese grants and public support programs using official data published by government agencies.

Rather than simply listing programs, this app compares public company information with program requirements and clearly separates confirmed matches, possible mismatches, missing information, and official sources. This helps users understand why a program may be relevant and what still needs to be verified.

The app can be used by business owners and project leaders researching support for their own organizations, as well as by professional advisors researching programs for their clients or preparing for consultations.

When useful, it can also reference public corporate information and historical selection statistics, and organize unresolved questions into a consultation brief for a qualified professional.

Results are provided for research and decision support only. They do not guarantee eligibility, selection, funding amounts, or legal compliance. Before applying, always confirm the latest official guidelines and information published by the administering organization.

Primary official sources
- J-Grants
- gBizINFO
- National Tax Agency Corporate Number System
- Financial Services Agency EDINET
